DSSSB Warder Result 2026 Post Code 15/25: The Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board (DSSSB) declared the Tier-I result for the Warder (Male) post, Post Code 15/25, on 27 April 2026. Candidates who took the Tier-I online exam can now view their marks and check whether they have been shortlisted for the Physical Endurance Test (PET). The board has also released the category-wise cutoff marks and, more recently, the PET schedule. This article covers everything available in the official notice result status, cutoff marks, important dates, how to check your score, and direct links to the official documents.

DSSSB Warder Result 2026 Post Code 15/25 - Quick Overview

Organization Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board (DSSSB)
Post Name Warder (Male)
Post Code 15/25
Total Vacancies 1,676
Exam Type Tier-I Online Exam
Result Status Released on 27 April 2026
Next Stage Physical Endurance Test (PET)

DSSSB Warder Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

Event Date
Tier-I Exam 24–28 November 2025 and 1–11 December 2025
Written (Tier-I) Result Declared 27 April 2026
Physical Endurance Test (PET) 12 September – 3 October 2026
E-Admit Card Download From 4 September 2026

DSSSB Warder PET Notice: Venue and Schedule

As per the official notice dated 18 August 2026 (Notice No. DSSSB-Exam0EX12/6/2026/Comp.No.371113/25/15), the Physical Endurance Test for shortlisted Warder (Male), Post Code 15/25 candidates will be conducted at two centres in Delhi:

  • Sports Complex, East Vinod Nagar, Delhi-110091
  • Thyagaraj Sports Complex, INA Colony, Delhi-110003

The PET will run across multiple dates, with two reporting shifts each day:

Shift Reporting Time
Shift I 7:30 AM to 8:00 AM
Shift II 9:30 AM to 10:00 AM

DSSSB Warder Result 2026: Key Details

Candidates who scored at or above the category-wise cutoff in the Tier-I exam have been shortlisted for the Physical Endurance Test. The board has clarified that this shortlist is provisional final selection will depend on document verification and confirmation that candidates meet all eligibility conditions. Qualifying Tier-I or being shortlisted for PET does not by itself guarantee final selection.

How to Check DSSSB Warder Result 2026 Post Code 15/25

  1. Visit the official DSSSB website: dsssb.delhi.gov.in, or the OARS candidate portal at dsssbonline.nic.in.
  2. Log in to your OARS account using your registered credentials.
  3. Locate the Post Code 15/25 (Warder Male) result/marks section.
  4. View and download your Tier-I marks.
  5. Save or print a copy of your result for future reference.

Important Instructions

  • The PET shortlist is provisional; it does not confirm final selection.
  • Candidates must meet all eligibility conditions, which will be verified during document verification.
  • E-admit cards for the PET can be downloaded from 4 September 2026 onward.
  • If you face any difficulty downloading the e-admit card, contact the DSSSB board office in person on 8–9 September 2026 (11:00 AM to 3:00 PM), or email [email protected] by 8 September 2026 (1:00 PM). Requests through any other channel will not be entertained.
  • Candidates should review the PET scheme detailed in Vacancy Advertisement Notice No. 01/2025 dated 4 July 2025, and strictly follow the General Instructions for Post Code 15/25 available on the DSSSB website.
  • Keep your registered email address and mobile number updated, since exam centre, date, and shift/timing details will be communicated via the e-admit card and registered mobile number. DSSSB has stated that non-receipt of an SMS will not entitle a candidate to an extension for downloading the e-admit card or to a re-examination.
  • Rely only on the official DSSSB website and OARS portal for updates; avoid unofficial sources for confirmation of results or schedules.

CSBC Bihar Police Special Branch Constable Cut Off 2026

As per the official guidelines, candidates must secure at least 30% marks in each paper to qualify the written examination. This section will be updated as soon as the category-wise cut-off is officially released.

Documents Required for PST and Document Verification

Shortlisted candidates must carry the following original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies on their scheduled PST date:

  • Valid photo ID proof (Aadhaar Card, Driving License, or Voter ID)
  • Matriculation / 10th Pass certificate and marksheet (for date of birth proof)
  • Intermediate / 12th Pass certificate and marksheet
  • Caste Certificate and Permanent Residence / Domicile Certificate issued by a competent authority
  • Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) Certificate for BC/EBC candidates
  • Income & Asset Certificate for EWS candidates (valid for FY 2024–2025)
  • Freedom Fighter Dependent (FFW) Certificate, if applicable

  • Any changes to the selection process or schedule will be communicated only through the official CSBC website — avoid relying on unverified sources.
  • Candidates found submitting incorrect or fraudulent documents at the verification stage may be disqualified as per CSBC rules.

A total of 215 candidates have been provisionally declared successful and are eligible to appear for the interview (Sakshatkar Pariksha) stage.

Result Highlights

Out of the candidates who appeared in the Main (Written) Examination, 215 candidates have been provisionally declared successful and shortlisted for the interview stage. The commission has not published the roll numbers within this article; candidates should check their roll number directly against the official result PDF released by UKPSC, as the list has intentionally been left out here.

UKPSC will verify the original documents of shortlisted candidates against the claims made in their online applications from 7 September 2026 to 9 September 2026 at the UKPSC office in Haridwar. A detailed notice regarding the schedule and required documents for this verification will be published on the commission's official website in due course. Specific document requirements are not available in the current notification.

  • This result is entirely provisional and subject to document verification and pending High Court cases.
  • Do not rely on unofficial sources for your roll number verify only through the official UKPSC result PDF or website.
  • Keep your original educational, residence, and reservation category documents ready ahead of the September 2026 verification window.
  • Regularly check www.psc.uk.gov.in for the separate interview notice and document verification schedule.

  • After document verification is completed, DSSSB declares the final result for that particular recruitment/post code.

Specific document requirements, verification schedules, and further instructions are issued separately for each post code by DSSSB, so candidates should refer to the official result notice PDF for their specific post for exact requirements.

What Is the APPSC Departmental Test?

The APPSC Departmental Test is not a recruitment examination. It is a qualifying test that serving Andhra Pradesh Government employees take to become eligible for promotions, transfers, and appointments to higher posts, as required under their respective Departmental Service Rules. Tests are conducted twice a year a May session and a November session and cover more than 60 distinct paper groups across departments such as Revenue, Excise, Forest, Police, Treasuries & Accounts, Jail, Registration, Transport, Fisheries, and various language and survey tests.

Papers are held in two modes: objective-type papers are Computer Based Tests (CBT), while Language Tests and Survey & Settlement papers are conducted in the conventional (descriptive, with books/without books as specified) mode.

What After the APPSC Departmental Test Result?

  • APPSC does not issue individual pass certificates for departmental tests; the published result PDF itself is treated as the official, authentic record of qualification.
  • Candidates who do not qualify can apply for a Memorandum of Marks within 1 month of the result declaration.
  • Qualified employees should retain a copy of the result PDF (or their register number entry) to submit as proof of eligibility for promotion, transfer, or appointment to the relevant higher post, as required by their department.
  • Any errata or corrections to the result, if issued, will be published as a separate "Errata" notice on the same official website candidates should keep checking the Announcements section for updates specific to Notification No. 03/2026.

Important Instructions

  • Always verify your result only through the official APPSC website psc.ap.gov.in or portal-psc.ap.gov.in. Do not rely on unofficial screenshots or social media forwards.

  • Keep your OTPR (One-Time Profile Registration) details and registration number handy for any further correspondence with APPSC regarding this result.
  • For discrepancies in your marks or register number, follow the Memorandum of Marks process rather than contacting the Commission by phone, as APPSC has specifically requested candidates not to call board members directly for such queries.

What the PNB LBO Score Card 2026 Contains

The individual scorecard is a diagnostic document distinct from the result PDF. It is issued to candidates who appeared in the online written test, regardless of whether they ultimately qualified. It typically displays:

  • Candidate's roll number and registration number
  • Section-wise marks scored in the online written examination
  • Overall/aggregate marks
  • Qualifying status (Qualified / Not Qualified) for that stage

Also Read: UP TGT 2026 Special Document Verification Admit Card

How to Download PNB LBO Score Card 2026

  1. Visit the official PNB recruitment page at pnb.bank.in, or go directly to the ibpsreg.ibps.in scorecard login portal.
  2. Locate the notice titled "Link to View Individual Scorecard" under the Local Bank Officer recruitment section.
  3. Enter your Registration Number / Application Number in the first field.
  4. Enter your Password, or your Date of Birth in DD-MM-YYYY format, in the second field.
  5. Click the Login/Submit button.
  6. Your section-wise scorecard will be displayed on screen.
  7. Download the PDF, or use Ctrl+P to save it as a PDF if no direct download option is shown.
  8. Take a printout and store it safely you will need it during document verification and joining formalities.

Category Minimum Marks Required Per Section

Candidates should cross-check exact figures against their own scorecard.

Separately, some exam-prep sources report an interview qualifying score of 25 out of 50 for General category candidates and 22.5 out of 50 for SC/ST candidates. Why Was the Reserve List Released?

After the CRP RRBs-XIV final result, a primary list of selected candidates was allotted to participating rural banks. However, some sanctioned posts remained vacant because certain selected candidates did not join within the deadline, resigned soon after joining, or were excluded during document verification. To ensure these vacancies are filled, IBPS has released this reserve list for candidates who cleared the exam but were not allotted a bank in the first round.

  4. Enter your Registration No/Roll No and Password/Date of Birth.
  5. Enter the captcha code and click Login.
  6. Check your provisional allotment status and download it for future reference.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Candidates provisionally allotted from the reserve list will also receive an intimation email and SMS on their registered contact details.
  • The allotment shown after login is provisional and will be confirmed only after the concerned bank completes document and eligibility verification.
  • Specific documents required for verification are not listed in the official notification. Candidates should follow the instructions issued directly by their allotted bank.
  • Candidates should keep checking their registered email and SMS regularly to avoid missing further communication or deadlines.

What Happens After Reserve List Allotment?

Based on the notification, candidates allotted through the reserve list can expect the following process, though exact dates and requirements are not specified:

  • Document Verification
  • Submission of Required Certificates
  • Medical Examination (if applicable)
  • Joining Formalities
  • Induction/Training Process

IBPS RRB Clerk Reserve List 2026 Out - Check Provisional Allotment (CRP XIV)

The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) released the IBPS RRB Clerk Reserve List 2026 on 30th June 2026 for candidates who appeared in the CRP RRBs-XIV recruitment cycle. Candidates who were not allotted a bank in the main result can now log in to the official IBPS portal with their registration number and password/date of birth to check their provisional allotment status under the reserve list. The list currently covers 26 participating Regional Rural Banks (RRBs), and shortlisted candidates will also be informed through email and SMS on their registered contact details.

What Is the IBPS RRB Clerk Reserve List 2026?

This section explains the purpose of the reserve list and why IBPS issues it after the main selection round.

A reserve list is a backup panel that IBPS prepares after declaring the final result of the CRP RRBs-XIV exam. Once the primary list of selected candidates is allotted to participating banks, some vacancies remain unfilled because certain selected candidates do not join within the deadline, resign shortly after joining, or get rejected at the document verification stage. To ensure every sanctioned post is filled, IBPS draws candidates from the reserve panel, based on merit, category, and the number of vacancies still open, and provisionally allots them to a Regional Rural Bank for the Office Assistant/Customer Service Associate (Clerk) post.

IBPS RRB Clerk Reserve List 2026: Direct Link to Check

This section gives you the official login link to view your provisional allotment status under the reserve list.

Candidates who appeared in the IBPS RRB Clerk Mains exam but did not feature in the original selection list can check their status through the official IBPS portal. Login requires your Registration Number/Roll Number and Password/Date of Birth.

IBPS RRB Clerk Reserve List 2026 Login Link (Active)

How to Check IBPS RRB Clerk Reserve List 2026 Online?

This section outlines the step-by-step process to view and download your reserve list allotment status.

  1. Visit the official IBPS website at ibps.in.
  2. Click on the "CRP-CSA (Customer Service Associate)" tab on the homepage.
  3. Select "CRP-CRP XIV – Provisional Allotment under Reserve List."
  4. Enter your Registration Number/Roll Number and Password/Date of Birth.
  5. Fill in the captcha code and click on the Login button.
  6. View your allotment status and download the result for future reference.

How Will You Know If You're Selected?

This section explains how IBPS notifies candidates who get provisional allotment through the reserve list.

Candidates who are provisionally allotted a bank through the reserve list will receive an official communication via email and SMS on their registered email ID and mobile number. It is advisable to regularly check your registered contact details and the official IBPS portal so you don't miss any update.

What Happens After the Reserve List Allotment?

This section explains the next stages candidates must complete after receiving a provisional allotment.

Getting your name on the reserve list does not mean final selection it is a provisional allotment that becomes confirmed only after the bank completes verification. The typical process that follows includes:

  • Document Verification: Submission of original certificates and identity proofs for cross-checking.
  • Submission of Required Certificates: Educational, category, and other eligibility-related documents as specified by the allotted bank.
  • Medical Examination: Some banks may require a fitness check before final confirmation.
  • Joining Formalities: Completion of paperwork and reporting to the allotted branch.
  • Induction/Training Process: Orientation and training conducted by the bank before you begin regular duties.

Candidates should keep all original and photocopied documents ready in advance to avoid last-minute issues during verification.

Why Does IBPS Release a Reserve List?

This section explains the broader purpose behind the reserve list mechanism in IBPS recruitment.

A reserve list helps maintain smooth recruitment by ensuring sanctioned vacancies don't remain vacant. It benefits candidates who narrowly missed the initial cut-off by giving them another opportunity, while also helping banks manage manpower requirements efficiently across states and categories.

If you're one of the shortlisted candidates, this is your final step before securing a role as a Circle Based Officer at SBI so let's walk through everything you need to know: where to download the call letter, what documents to carry, and how the final selection is calculated.

What Is the SBI CBO Interview Call Letter 2026?

The SBI CBO Interview Call Letter is the official admission ticket that confirms a candidate has cleared the earlier stages and is now eligible to appear for the personal interview round.

The interview call letter is a mandatory document for the SBI CBO Recruitment 2026 drive, which is being conducted to fill 2,050 vacancies for the Circle Based Officer post across various states and language zones. Without this call letter, candidates will not be permitted entry into the interview venue, so downloading and verifying it well in advance is essential.

  • Original and photocopies of educational certificates and mark sheets
  • Recent passport-size photographs (the same one used during application, if specified)

Candidates should keep all documents organized in a single folder to avoid last-minute confusion at the venue.

SBI CBO 2026 Selection Process Explained

Understanding how your final selection is calculated helps you prepare strategically for the interview. This section explains the complete selection methodology for SBI CBO 2026.

The SBI Circle Based Officer recruitment follows a multi-stage selection process:

  1. Online Examination - The first screening stage testing candidates' aptitude and knowledge.
  2. Screening/Shortlisting - Candidates are shortlisted based on online exam performance for the interview stage.
  3. Interview - Worth 50 marks, assessing banking awareness, professional knowledge, and communication skills.
  4. Local Language Proficiency Test - Candidates must demonstrate proficiency in the regional/local language relevant to their applied state or circle.

How Is the Final Merit List Prepared?

The final selection isn't based on the interview alone it combines scores from multiple stages using a fixed weightage formula.

The final merit list for SBI CBO 2026 is prepared using combined weightage:

  • Online Examination: 75% weightage
  • Interview: 25% weightage

This means strong performance in the online exam significantly boosts your overall chances, but a good interview score remains essential for the final cutoff.

CBI Apprentice Vacancy Details 2026

The Central Bank of India has announced a total of 4,500 Apprentice vacancies for the financial year 2026-27, distributed across various states and union territories. Maharashtra and Uttar Pradesh reportedly have the largest state-wise allocations. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification PDF on the bank's recruitment page for the exact state-wise and category-wise vacancy breakup, since detailed figures for every state were not confirmed in the sources reviewed for this article.

Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must meet the educational qualification, age limit, and nationality conditions set by the Central Bank of India to be eligible for the Apprentice post.

Educational Qualification

  • A graduation degree (bachelor's degree) in any discipline from a recognised university or institute.
  • Candidates should have completed graduation on or after 1 January 2022 (some sources indicate the cut-off as 1 January 2021; candidates should verify the exact date on the official notification).
  • Candidates with one year or more of work or training experience after graduation are not eligible, since this scheme is meant for fresh graduates.
  • Candidates who have already completed apprenticeship training, or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training elsewhere, are not eligible.
  • Basic computer knowledge is required.
  • Candidates must be proficient in the local language of the state they are applying for.

Age Limit

Candidates must be between 20 and 28 years of age as on 31 May 2026, meaning they should be born between 31 May 1998 and 31 May 2006 (both dates inclusive).

Category Age Relaxation
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years
SC / ST 5 years
PwBD (UR/EWS) 10 years
PwBD (OBC) 13 years
PwBD (SC/ST) 15 years

Candidates should check the official notification for the exact category-wise age relaxation applicable to them.

Salary / Stipend Details

Selected apprentices will receive a fixed monthly stipend of ₹15,000 during the 12-month training period. This is a training stipend rather than a regular salary, and no other allowances or benefits are provided. Completion of the apprenticeship does not guarantee permanent employment with the bank.

Application Fee

The exact application fee amount for the CBI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 was not confirmed in the sources reviewed for this article. Candidates should refer to the official Central Bank of India Apprentice notification PDF on centralbank.bank.in for accurate, category-wise fee details, since this cannot be reliably stated here.

Selection Process

The Central Bank of India Apprentice selection process involves two stages:

  1. Online Written Examination: An objective-type computer-based test with no negative marking for wrong answers.
  2. Local Language Proficiency Test: Candidates who qualify the online exam may need to appear for a test assessing reading, writing, and speaking skills in the local language of the applied state. Candidates who studied the local language at Class 10 or Class 12 level may be exempted from this test, subject to document verification.

Final selection also depends on document verification and meeting the required medical fitness standards set by the bank.

Documents Required at the Exam Centre

  • Printed copy of the CBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026
  • A valid original government-issued photo ID proof, such as Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Passport, Voter ID, or Driving Licence
  • A photocopy of the photo ID for verification
  • Recent passport-size photographs, as specified in the admit card instructions

Candidates should ensure the name on their ID proof matches the name printed on the admit card to avoid denial of entry.

How to Download the CBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026

Follow these steps to download your Central Bank of India Apprentice hall ticket:

  1. Visit the official website of the Central Bank of India at centralbankofindia.co.in or centralbank.bank.in.
  2. Go to the "Recruitment" or "Careers" section on the homepage.
  3. Click on the "CBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026" or "Download Call Letter" link.
  4. Enter your Registration Number/Roll Number and Password or Date of Birth.
  5. Fill in the captcha code, if required.
  6. Click the Login or Submit button.
  7. Your CBI Apprentice Hall Ticket 2026 will appear on the screen.
  8. Carefully verify all details, including your name, photograph, signature, exam date, and exam centre.
  9. Download the admit card and take a clear printout on an A4 sheet for the examination.

The online written examination consists of 100 objective-type questions worth 100 marks, to be completed in 60 minutes, with no negative marking.

  • Carry the printed admit card; digital copies on a phone or tablet are typically not accepted.

Downloading the RBI Grade B call letter is a straightforward process. The same steps apply for both Phase 1 (already released) and Phase 2 (upcoming). Follow the steps below to access your hall ticket from the official website.

Carrying the right documents to the examination centre is mandatory. Entry will not be granted if the candidate fails to produce valid identity proof along with the printed admit card.

Every candidate must bring the following on exam day:

Printed copy of the RBI Grade B Admit Card 2026, 2 recent passport-size photographs, one valid original Photo ID proof such as Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Passport, Voter ID, or Driving Licence, and a photocopy of the same Photo ID.

RBI Grade B Exam Pattern 2026

Understanding the exam pattern helps candidates prepare effectively for both phases of the selection process. The RBI Grade B selection consists of Phase 1 (Prelims), Phase 2 (Mains), and an Interview round.

Phase 1 Exam Pattern - Objective Type (Qualifying)

Phase 1 is a 2-hour online objective exam carrying 200 marks across 200 questions. Since it is only qualifying, candidates must clear it to advance to Mains, but these marks do not count toward the final score.

Candidates must reach the exam centre before the gate closing time without fail. Biometric verification including thumb impression and photograph capture will be conducted at the centre. Ensure your name on the admit card matches exactly with your photo ID. Wearing clothes with metal items, large buttons, or accessories that could trigger security checks should be avoided. Electronic devices including mobile phones, smart watches, Bluetooth devices, calculators, and books are strictly prohibited inside the examination hall. The exam centre and date allotted on the call letter are final no requests for change of centre, date, or session will be entertained.

Indian Airforce Agniveer Vayu Musician Intake Bharti 2026 : Educational Qualification

  • Passed Matriculation / 10th or equivalent with minimum pass marks from any Govt. recognized School / Board.
  • Music Ability – 
  1. Candidates must have proficiency in music with accuracy in tempo, pitch and singing one complete song. They should be able to perform one preparatory tune and any of the notations i.e. Staff notation/ Tablature/ Tonic Solfa/ Hindustani/ Carnatic etc. Candidates must be able to tune individual instruments (in case of instruments require tuning) and match unknown notes on vocal or instruments.
  2. Candidates must have proficiency in playing any one instrument
  • Musical Experience Certificate –
  1. Grade 5th or equivalent or above in one instrument from a recognized music institute such as TCL or RSM, KM Music Conservatory, Bangalore School of Music, TSM, GMI, Berklee School of Music etc. OR
  2. Diploma or equivalent in the field of music for candidates performing Hindustani or Carnatic Classical Music from any recognized University. OR
  3. Certificate of participation/ awards presented at various events. For such candidates’ performance/ playing of blowing instruments with staff notation.
  • All candidates must read the official information completely before applying.

Indian Airforce Agniveer Vayu Musician Intake Online Form 2026 : Physical Eligibility Details

  • Height –
  1. For Male candidates: Minimum acceptable height is 162 cms.
  2. For Female candidates: Minimum acceptable height is 152 cms. For candidates belonging to North East or hilly regions of Uttarakhand, a lower minimum height of 147 cms will be accepted. In case of candidates from Lakshadweep, the minimum height will be 150 cms
  • Weight – Weight should be proportionate to height and age as applicable for IAF.
  • Chest –
  • For Male Candidates: The chest wall should be well proportioned and well developed. Minimum chest circumference should be 77 cms and the chest expansion should be at least 05 cms
  • For Female candidates: The chest wall should be well proportioned and well developed with the minimum range of expansion of 05 cms.
  1. Hearing – Candidate should have normal hearing i.e. able to hear forced whisper from a distance of 6 meters by each ear separately.
  2. Dental – Should have healthy gums, good set of teeth and minimum 14 dental points.
  • Visual Standards – 6/12 each eye, correctable to 6/6 each eye; Maximum limits of Refractive Error:- Hypermetropia: +2.0D, Myopia: 1D, Including ± 0.50 D Astigmatism & Colour Vision: CP-II
  • Physical Fitness Test (PFT) – PFT consists of a 1.6 Km run to be completed within 7 minutes (For Male Candidates) and 1.6 KM run to be completed within 8 minutes (For Female Candidates).
  • Candidates will have to complete 10 push-ups, 10 sit-ups and 20 squats Form (Male) & 10 sit-ups and 15 squats (Female).

  • This document is used as a certificate of date of birth and educational qualification.

PwBD / Disability Certificate (If Applicable)
  • The person with disability must have a disability certificate issued by a special medical board clearly stating the percentage of disability.
Ex-Serviceman Certificate (If Applicable)
  • Candidates must possess a valid Discharge Book or Service Certificate, in which the length of service is clearly mentioned.
Bank Account Details
  • Candidates must provide the account holder’s name, account number, and IFSC code, which are required for fee refund or future payments.
Domicile / Address Proof (If Asked)
  • Candidates may need to provide a state domicile certificate along with their permanent and correspondence address details, if required.
Other Useful Documents
  • Candidates must keep an active email ID and mobile number, along with the application/confirmation page printout and fee payment receipt, for future reference.
Note : Candidates must Keep all documents scanned and ready before form filling. Fill name, DOB, and parents’ names exactly as per 10th marksheet. Incorrect or fake documents can cancel selection. Carry originals with self-attested photocopies for verification.

Bank of Baroda (BOB) has released the BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026 notification for the appointment of 2482 Local Bank Officer (LBO) vacancies on a regular basis across 20 states of India. This BOB LBO Recruitment 2026 drive, issued under Advertisement No. BOB/HRM/REC/ADVT/2026/16, invites applications from eligible Indian citizens who are graduates with at least one year of post-qualification experience as an officer in a Scheduled Commercial Bank.

Candidates looking for BOB Local Bank Officer Vacancy 2026 details, eligibility, application fee, salary, and how to apply online can check the complete information below, based directly on the official Bank of Baroda notification.

Quick facts: Bank of Baroda is recruiting for the post of Local Bank Officer (JMG/S-I) with 2482 vacancies. Graduates in any discipline with a minimum of 1 year of post-qualification banking officer experience and proficiency in the local language of the state applied for can apply. Online registration starts on 18.08.2026 and closes on 07.09.2026. Applications must be submitted online through the Bank's official website, and selected candidates will be posted within the state they apply for.

BOB Local Bank Officer Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfil the following eligibility conditions, assessed as on the cut-off date of 01.08.2026, to apply for BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026.

Criteria Details
Nationality Citizen of India, or subject of Nepal/Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1 January 1962 with intent to permanently settle, or a person of Indian origin who migrated from specified countries (Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia, Vietnam) with intent to permanently settle in India
Educational Qualification Graduation in any discipline from a recognized University/Institution (mandatory)
Preferred Certifications IC 38 (Insurance Institute of India), NISM Series V-A (Mutual Fund Distributors), NISM Series XXI-A (PMS Distributors), NISM Series XIII (Common Derivatives)
Post-Qualification Experience Minimum 1 year as an Officer in any Scheduled Commercial Bank listed in the Second Schedule of the Reserve Bank of India
Language Proficiency Must be proficient (reading, writing, speaking, understanding) in the local language of the state applied for

Candidates who have resigned from an officer-grade position in Bank of Baroda, or exited the Bank while on contract within the last three years as on the cut-off date, are not eligible to apply. Employees currently working in Bank of Baroda in the officer cadre or on contract basis are also not eligible.

Salary and other emoluments will be governed by the industry-level bipartite settlement and Joint Note applicable to bank officers, along with bank-specific allowances and perquisites as revised from time to time.

BOB Local Bank Officer Age Limit

The age limit indicated below is for General category candidates as on the cut-off date of 01.08.2026.

  • Maximum Age: 30 years

There is no reservation for Ex-Servicemen in the Officers' Cadre; only age relaxation as above applies. OBC candidates in the "creamy layer" are not entitled to OBC reservation or age relaxation.

Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

BOB Local Bank Officer Selection Process

Selection for BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026 will be based on the following stages:

  • Online Test (multiple sections, described below)
  • Group Discussion (GD) and/or Personal Interview (PI)
  • Psychometric Test and/or any other assessment as deemed suitable by the Bank
  • Local Language Proficiency Test (LPT), where applicable

The tentative structure of the online examination is as follows:

Section Name of Test No. of Questions Maximum Marks Duration
1 English Language 30 30 30 Minutes
2 Banking Knowledge 30 30 30 Minutes
3 General/Economic Awareness 30 30 30 Minutes
4 Reasoning Ability & Quantitative Aptitude 30 30 30 Minutes
- Total 120 120 120 Minutes

The English Language section is qualifying in nature only, and marks scored in it will not count towards the final merit list. There is a penalty of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer. The minimum qualifying marks for GD/PI are 60% for General category and 55% for Reserved category candidates. Candidates must qualify in the Local Language Proficiency Test unless they have studied the local language at the 10th or 12th standard level.

  • Bank of Baroda LBO Syllabus 2026

How to Apply for BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates can apply online for BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026 by following the steps below.

  1. Visit the official Bank of Baroda website: www.bankofbaroda.bank.in
  2. Go to the Career section/webpage and click on "Current Opportunities".
  3. Register online and fill in the application form for Local Bank Officer.
  4. Upload the required documents, including scanned photograph, signature, resume, DOB proof, educational certificates, work experience certificates, and caste/PWBD certificate (if applicable).
  5. Verify all details carefully before submission, as no changes are allowed after clicking Submit.
  6. Pay the application fee online using Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, or UPI.
  7. Take a printout of the completed application form and fee receipt for future reference.

BOB Local Bank Officer Important Instructions

  • Candidates can apply for only one state; multiple applications will result in forfeiture of fees for extra registrations.
  • No change of category is permitted at any stage after registration of the online application.
  • Candidates must possess a valid personal email ID and mobile number, kept active till completion of the recruitment process.
  • Candidates are advised to possess or acquire a valid Aadhaar card, as Online Aadhaar verification will be conducted at various stages.
  • Biometric data/IRIS scan and photograph will be captured and verified before the online examination, at GD/interview, and at the time of joining.
  • Mobile phones, pagers, calculators, or similar devices are not allowed inside the examination premises.
  • Selected candidates will be posted within the state applied for the first 12 years of service or until promotion to SMGS-IV grade, whichever is earlier.
  • Selected candidates will be on probation for 12 months from the date of joining.
  • Selected candidates must execute a Service Bond to serve a minimum of 3 years, or pay an amount equivalent to three months' gross salary (not exceeding Rs. 2 Lakhs) if they leave before completing three years of service.
  • Any legal disputes arising from this recruitment fall under the exclusive jurisdiction of courts/tribunals in Mumbai.

In addition to basic pay, selected candidates receive Dearness Allowance, HRA/subsidized housing, medical facilities, gratuity, contributory provident fund, group personal accident insurance, LTC/LFA, superannuation benefit fund, conveyance advance, and Performance Related Pay (PRP), as per Corporation rules.

Service Bond

Grade General Category EWS/OBC(NCL)/SC/ST/PwBD
Grade A ₹3,00,000 ₹50,000
Grade A0/E0 ₹2,00,000 ₹35,000

Selected candidates must serve a minimum bond period of 3 years from the date of joining.

IOCL Executive Recruitment Selection Process

Selection comprises three stages: Computer Based Test (CBT), Group Discussion (GD) & Group Task (GT), and Personal Interview (PI).

CBT Pattern

Section Subject Questions Time
A – General Aptitude Quantitative Aptitude 20 60 min (80 min with compensatory time)
Logical Reasoning 15
Verbal Ability (English) 15
B – Domain Knowledge Post-specific technical/domain questions 50 90 min (120 min with compensatory time)
Total 100 150 min
  • Each question carries 1 mark; 0.25 marks deducted for every incorrect answer.
  • Section order is fixed - Section A first, then Section B.
  • CBT will be held at 83 test centers across India (city list available in the official notification and syllabus link below).

Qualifying Standard in CBT

Category Each Section (A & B) Overall Minimum
General/EWS/OBC(NCL) 40% 45%
SC/ST 35% 40%
PwBD 25% 30%

Composite Score Weightage

Component Weightage
Computer Based Test (CBT) 85%
Group Discussion (GD) & Group Task (GT) 5%
Personal Interview (PI) 10%

Minimum composite score required: General/EWS/OBC(NCL) – 45%, SC/ST – 40%, PwBD – 30%. GD/GT and PI each require a minimum 40% pass mark.

How to Apply for IOCL Executive Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official website www.iocl.com and click "Apply Online."
  2. Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, contact details, and email ID to generate a Provisional Registration Number and Password.
  3. Log in and fill the application form; use "Save and Next" to save progress at each stage.
  4. Upload scanned photograph (4.5cm x 3.5cm, 20–50 KB), signature (10–20 KB), and left thumb impression (20–50 KB) as per specifications.
  5. Capture a live photograph via webcam or mobile phone as prompted by the portal.
  6. Fill in educational, category, and other required details.
  7. Preview the form carefully, then click "Complete Registration" - no changes are allowed after this step.
  8. Proceed to the Payment tab and pay the application fee online.
  9. Click "Submit" and download/print the completed application form and e-receipt for your records.
Important: Only one application per post is allowed; in case of multiple applications, the latest one is treated as final. SC/ST/PwBD candidates are exempt from the application fee; all other candidates must pay ₹1,000 + GST.

Documents Required

  • Qualifying degree/diploma certificate and mark sheets (as applicable to the post)
  • CGPA-to-percentage conversion certificate, if applicable
  • Work experience proof (for Law Officer and Assistant Quality Control Officer posts) on organizational letterhead
  • Bar Council of India registration certificate (for Law Officer candidates with independent practice)
  • Birth date proof (Board of Secondary Education matriculation/higher-secondary certificate)
  • Category certificate (EWS/OBC(NCL)/SC/ST), as applicable, in the latest prescribed format
  • PwBD certificate and UDID card, where applicable
  • Valid photo identity proof (PAN/Passport/Driving License/Voter ID/Aadhaar, etc.)
  • No Objection Certificate (NOC) from current employer, if presently employed in Government/PSU/Autonomous Body

Important Conditions

  • Candidates having their graduation/diploma in combined, integrated, or interdisciplinary subjects (e.g., Mechatronics, Robotics) are not eligible for the Graduate Engineer or Diploma Engineer posts.
  • No change of category (Gen/EWS/SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD) is permitted once submitted in the online application.
  • Selected candidates will be placed anywhere in India, including overseas offices, at Corporation discretion.
  • Final selection is provisional and subject to subsequent verification of certificates, testimonials, and medical fitness.
  • Candidates must clear Pre-Employment Medical Examination (PEME) guidelines before joining.
  • Any use of unfair means, impersonation, or misconduct during the process will lead to disqualification and may result in debarment from future IOCL examinations.
  • IOCL reserves the right to cancel, restrict, enlarge, modify, or alter the recruitment/selection process without prior notice.

RRB JE & DMS Eligibility 2026

Educational Qualification

Post Qualification
Junior Engineer (all categories) Three years Diploma in Engineering (or a combination of sub-streams) in the discipline mapped to the post - Mechanical, Electrical, Civil or Electronics & Allied Engineering - from a recognized University/Institute; higher qualifications such as B.E./B.Tech in the same discipline are also acceptable

A candidate possessing more than one minimum educational qualification mapped to different Exam Groups can choose only one Exam Group, and must opt for posts whose qualification is mapped to that chosen group. A candidate must be a citizen of India, a citizen of Nepal, a subject of Bhutan, or a person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, or specified East African/other countries with the intention of permanently settling in India (subject to a certificate of eligibility from the Government of India where applicable).

RRB JE & DMS Selection Process 2026

Selection comprises four stages: 1st Stage CBT, 2nd Stage CBT, Document Verification (DV) and Medical Examination (ME).

1st Stage CBT (Common, Screening)

Section Questions Marks
Mathematics 30 30
General Intelligence & Reasoning 25 25
General Awareness 15 15
General Science 30 30
Total 100 100

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for scribe-eligible candidates). This stage is of screening nature; the normalized score is used only for shortlisting to the 2nd Stage CBT, at 15 times the community-wise vacancy for each RRB.

2nd Stage CBT (Discipline-Specific)

Section Questions Marks
General Awareness 15 15
Physics & Chemistry 15 15
Basics of Computers & Applications 10 10
Basics of Environment & Pollution Control 10 10
Technical Abilities (Exam Group specific) 100 100
Total 150 150
  • Duration: 120 minutes (160 minutes for scribe-eligible candidates); a virtual calculator is provided on screen.
  • Negative marking: 1/3rd mark deducted for each wrong answer, in both stages of CBT.
  • Minimum qualifying marks: UR & EWS 40%, OBC-NCL & SC 30%, ST 25% (relaxable by up to 2 marks for PwBD candidates in case of shortage against reserved vacancies).
  • Document Verification is based on merit and options in the 2nd Stage CBT; the number of candidates called equals the number of vacancies.
  • Medical Examination follows the post-specific medical standard; candidates found medically unfit are not offered any alternative appointment.

How to Apply for RRB JE & DMS Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official RRB website and use the link provided for CEN No. 04/2026.
  2. Create an Account using a valid personal mobile number and email ID (these cannot be changed later); use existing login credentials if already registered for an earlier RRB CEN.
  3. Optionally authenticate identity using DigiLocker/Aadhaar at the account-creation stage for smoother verification later.
  4. Choose only one RRB and indicate order of preference for Railway Zones/Production Units and posts/categories you are eligible for.
  5. Fill in personal and educational details, and select the medium of examination and Exam Group.
  6. Capture a live photograph through the application module (pre-existing photos are not accepted) and upload your signature in JPG/JPEG format (30–49 KB).
  7. SC/ST candidates seeking a free train travel pass must upload their SC/ST certificate in PDF (under 400 KB).
  8. Pay the examination fee online via net banking, debit/credit card, or UPI.
  9. Submit the application and note down the Registration Number for future reference.
  10. Use the modification window (16–25 September 2026) if corrections are needed, on payment of a ₹250 modification fee per occasion.
Important: Multiple applications to different RRBs, or more than one application to the same RRB, will lead to rejection of all applications and debarment from future RRB/RRC examinations.

Documents Required

  • Original Diploma/Degree certificates and mark sheets, with two sets of self-attested photocopies
  • Matriculation/SSC/SSLC certificate as proof of date of birth
  • Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/EBC) in the prescribed annexure format, where applicable
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) certificate and UDID, where applicable
  • Ex-Servicemen discharge/employment certificate and self-declaration, where applicable
  • No Objection Certificate (NOC) from present employer, for serving Central/State Government or PSU employees
  • Aadhaar/DigiLocker details used for identity verification
  • Colour passport-size photograph, not older than two months, at each stage (CBT/DV/Medical Examination)
  • Scribe-related certificates and letters of undertaking, for eligible PwBD candidates using scribe assistance

Important Conditions

  • Candidates must possess the prescribed educational qualification as on the closing date of application; those awaiting final results are not eligible to apply.
  • Vacancies indicated are provisional and may increase, decrease, or become nil, based on Railway Administration requirements.
  • Negative marking of 1/3rd mark per wrong answer applies at both stages of CBT.
  • Request for change of examination centre, date, or shift will not be entertained under any circumstances.
  • Candidates found medically unfit for their opted post will not be offered any alternative appointment.
  • Once empanelled against a post/Railway/category, candidates forfeit the right to be considered for any other post/category within the same Pay Level.
  • RRBs reserve the right to modify, cancel, or reschedule any stage of recruitment, and to change vacancy numbers, at any point.
  • Use of unfair means, impersonation, or submission of false information leads to lifetime debarment from all RRB/RRC examinations and possible legal action.

How to Apply for Nainital Bank Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026

Candidates can apply online only from 15 August 2026 to 7 September 2026; no other mode of application will be accepted.

  1. Go to the "Career" section of the Bank's website at www.nainitalbank.bank.in, click "Current Openings" under the Recruitment tab, and click "Apply Online".
  2. Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter your Name, Contact details, and Email ID. Note down the system-generated Provisional Registration Number and Password (also sent by Email/SMS).
  3. Use the "Save and Next" facility to fill the form in stages if required, and verify details carefully before final submission.
  4. Upload your scanned Photograph and Signature as per the specifications given in the notification (Photograph: 4.5cm × 3.5cm, 200×230 pixels, 20–50 KB; Signature: 140×60 pixels, 10–20 KB).
  5. Upload your scanned Left Thumb Impression (240×240 pixels, 200 DPI, 20–50 KB) and a handwritten declaration in English on white paper with black ink (800×400 pixels, 200 DPI, 50–100 KB) - text: "I, (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."
  6. Fill in all remaining details of the application form and click the Preview tab to verify the entire form before Complete Registration.
  7. Click "Complete Registration" only after confirming that the photograph, signature, and all details are correct, since no changes are possible thereafter.
  8. Click the "Payment" tab and pay the application fee of Rs. 1,500 (including GST) through the available online payment modes.
  9. Click "Submit" and take a printout of the e-Receipt and the completed online application form for future reference.

All particulars mentioned in the online application - Name, Category, Date of Birth, Address, Mobile Number, Email ID, Centre of Examination, etc. - are considered final; no change or modification is allowed after submission.

Nainital Bank Specialist Officer Important Instructions

  • Signature and the handwritten declaration must be in the candidate's own handwriting and in English only; signatures in CAPITAL LETTERS will not be accepted.
  • Photograph must be a recent passport-style colour picture against a light/white background, without caps, hats, or dark glasses (religious headwear allowed if it does not cover the face).
  • Candidates must produce, in original, a currently valid photo ID proof (PAN Card, Passport, Permanent Driving License, Voter's Card, Bank Passbook with photograph, Aadhaar/e-Aadhaar, Employee ID, Bar Council ID, etc.) along with a photocopy at the examination and interview. Ration Card and Learner's Driving License are NOT valid ID proof.
  • The name on the call letter must exactly match the name on the photo ID proof; candidates who have changed their name (e.g., after marriage) must carry the original Gazette notification/marriage certificate/affidavit.
  • Candidates found with an unclear/blurred photo or signature in capital letters on the admit card will not be allowed to appear for the exam.
  • Mobile phones or similar electronic communication devices are strictly prohibited in the examination/interview hall.
  • A candidate is allowed to appear only once in the online examination for a post; multiple appearances will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • Guidelines for scribe/compensatory time are provided for visually impaired candidates and candidates with locomotor disability/cerebral palsy or other specified disabilities under the RPWD Act, 2016, with prescribed certificates (Appendix-I) and undertakings (Appendix-II) as detailed in the official notification.
  • The application fee, once paid, is non-refundable under any circumstances and will not be held in reserve for any future examination or selection.

AAI Apprentice Selection Process

Selection is merit-based, with no written examination. The process comprises:

  1. Provisional selection based on the percentage of marks obtained in the qualifying examination (CGPA converted to percentage per the concerned Board/University norms). In case of a tie, date of birth and thereafter date of passing determine seniority.
  2. Document Verification at the establishment office, intimated only through the candidate's registered email ID.
  3. Interview / Certificate Verification, with candidature remaining provisional throughout.
  4. Medical Fitness Certificate (from a Government Medical Officer or Medical Officer of a Government Undertaking only), to be submitted at the time of joining.
  5. Final selection and issuance of the apprentice engagement letter follow successful document verification and medical fitness clearance.
Note: Merely being shortlisted for document verification or the medical examination does not entitle a candidate to selection as an Apprentice. Reservation for SC/ST, OBC, and EWS is applicable; if candidates are unavailable in a reserved category, the seat will be filled from other reserved/general categories.

How to Apply for AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27

  3. Verify your mobile number and email via OTP, then complete Aadhaar e-KYC verification.
  4. Fill the registration form (basic details auto-populate from UIDAI); add educational details and set a password, then submit.
  5. Verify your account via the email link sent to you, then log in and complete your profile: Basic Details, Educational Details (upload/fetch certificate via DigiLocker/APAAR), Communication Details, and Training Preferences.
  6. Preview your profile and submit it finally to receive your Student Enrolment ID.
  7. Search for establishment Airports Authority of India – RHQ NR, New Delhi (NDLSWC000002) and click Apply for the apprenticeship opportunity of your choice.

ITI Trade Apprentices – NAPS Portal

NTPC Limited, India's largest integrated power utility and a Government of India Enterprise, has released Advertisement No. 10/26 inviting online applications from experienced professionals for the post of Deputy Manager (E-4 Grade) in the disciplines of Electrical, Mechanical, and C&I (Control & Instrumentation). NTPC has an installed capacity of over 91 GW and has embarked on an ambitious plan to attain a total installed capacity of 149 GW by 2032.

NTPC is inviting applications for 135 Deputy Manager (E-4 Grade) posts - 40 posts in Electrical, 55 posts in Mechanical, and 40 posts in C&I. These are experienced-professional (lateral) positions requiring a minimum of 10 years of post-qualification executive experience, with an upper age limit of 40 years for all three disciplines. Eligible candidates hold a full-time B.E./B.Tech degree in the relevant discipline with at least 60% marks. All three posts carry the E-4 Grade/IDA pay scale of Rs. 70,000–2,00,000 per month. The online application window opens on 12 August 2026 and closes on 26 August 2026. Posting can be at any Station, Project, JV, or Subsidiary of NTPC, and all posts are transferable at the sole discretion of the Management.

  • NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

NTPC has advertised a total of 135 Deputy Manager (E-4 Grade) posts across three engineering disciplines. The projected vacancies indicated may increase or decrease as per organisational requirement, at the discretion of NTPC Management. The vacancies indicated include backlog vacancies.

NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

A. Deputy Manager (Electrical) – 40 Posts

Qualification: B.E./B.Tech Degree in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics with at least 60% marks from a recognised University/Institution.

Experience Profile: Minimum 10 years of post-qualification executive experience (including training period, if any) in the power sector (Coal, Gas, Lignite) in Operation/Maintenance/Commissioning/Erection/Engineering/Energy Efficiency/Project Management/Field Quality, or a combination thereof, in the relevant discipline.

B. Deputy Manager (Mechanical) – 55 Posts

Qualification: B.E./B.Tech Degree in Mechanical/Production with at least 60% marks from a recognised University/Institution.

Experience Profile: Minimum 10 years of post-qualification executive experience (including training period, if any) in the power sector (Coal, Gas, Lignite) in Operation/Maintenance/Commissioning/Erection/Engineering/Energy Efficiency/Project Management/Field Quality, or a combination thereof, in the relevant discipline.

C. Deputy Manager (C&I) – 40 Posts

Qualification: B.E./B.Tech Degree in Electronics/Control & Instrumentation/Instrumentation with at least 60% marks from a recognised University/Institution.

Experience Profile: Minimum 10 years of post-qualification executive experience (including training period, if any) in the power sector (Coal, Gas, Lignite) in Operation/Maintenance/Commissioning/Erection/Engineering/Energy Efficiency/Project Management/Field Quality, or a combination thereof, in the relevant discipline.

Experience Norms for Govt/PSU Candidates (Common for All Three Posts)

  • Out of the 10 years of post-qualification executive experience mentioned above (including training/trainee period, if any) in the executive cadre, candidates currently working in a Govt/Public Sector Undertaking should have a minimum of 2 years of experience in the pay scale of Rs. 60,000–1,80,000 or above (IDA pay scale of E-3 Grade or above of NTPC, effective from 01.01.2017) or an equivalent scale.
  • Such candidates must also provide a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer while applying for the post.

Relaxations for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD Candidates

  • In terms of educational qualification, only pass marks are required for SC/ST/PwBD candidates to apply (i.e., the 60% marks criterion does not apply to these categories).
  • The total years of experience required will be relaxed by 2 years for SC/ST candidates.

Health Standards

Before joining, candidates will have to undergo a medical examination by the NTPC Medical Board/Officer, and their decision will be final and binding. No relaxation in prescribed health standards is allowed. Detailed medical norms are available on the website careers.ntpc.co.in; all applicants are advised to review these norms before applying.

NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 Pay Scale

All three posts - Deputy Manager (Electrical), Deputy Manager (Mechanical), and Deputy Manager (C&I) - are at the E-4 Grade level, carrying the IDA pay scale of Rs. 70,000 – 2,00,000 per month (w.e.f. 01.01.2017). The notification does not specify additional allowances or gross salary figures beyond this pay scale.

Offline mode: State Bank of India has been authorised to collect the application fee in a specially opened account (A/C No. 30987919993) at the CAG Branch, New Delhi (Branch Code: 00996), on behalf of NTPC. Candidates must approach the nearest SBI branch with a printout of the "pay-in-slip" available on the application portal, and use only this pay-in-slip to deposit the fee, to ensure proper crediting. The bank will issue a unique Journal Number and Branch Code, which the candidate must enter in the online application. NTPC will not be responsible if a candidate deposits the fee into the wrong account.

Online mode: Candidates also have the option to pay the fee online through Net Banking, Debit Card, or Credit Card, within the online application form itself. The fee, once paid, will not be refunded under any circumstances; candidates are advised to verify their eligibility before paying the fee.

Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

In order to restrict the number of candidates for the selection process, if required, NTPC Management reserves the right to conduct a multi-stage selection process, which may comprise:

  • Application shortlisting/screening (based on qualification, percentage of marks, number of years of post-qualification experience, etc.)
  • Written/Computer-Based Test
  • Personal Interview
  • Or a combination of the above

NTPC Management also reserves the right to raise the minimum eligibility standards or criteria as per requirement. Meeting the minimum eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement does not by itself entitle a candidate to be shortlisted or called for the Written/Computer-Based Test or Interview, or to be considered further in the selection process.

Documents Required for NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026

Candidates must upload all required documents while applying; applications with incomplete or insufficient documents are liable to be rejected or not considered for further process.

  • Class X passing certificate/Mark sheet and PAN Card, for proof of Name and Date of Birth (Name and DOB should appear in conformity on all documents).
  • B.E./B.Tech Degree (Final/Provisional) certificate.
  • Engineering consolidated Mark sheet/Transcript, or all-semester mark sheets clearly indicating aggregate percentage of marks in all semesters.
  • Marks conversion formula from the university/institute, for conversion of CGPA/CGPI/DGPA/CGI/CPI etc. into a percentage.
  • Caste/Disability certificate (for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD/EWS candidates), as applicable.
  • OBC-NCL certificate in the central format, for the current financial year (FY 2026-27).
  • Current-year Income & Asset certificate for EWS candidates, valid for FY 2026-27 based on FY 2025-26 income.
  • Disability certificate as per the latest prescribed Central Government format, generated online through the Swalamban/UDID portal, clearly indicating the type and percentage of disability in line with the identified disability categories for the post.
  • All experience-related documents for each organisation/company, placed together in chronological order from the first to the last/current company, which may include: Experience/Service Certificate (as per NTPC's prescribed sample format); Offer of Appointment/Appointment Letter/Offer Letter with Confirmation/Absorption Letter/Order on Completion of Training (if any); Joining Order/Letter; Role Assignment orders; Promotion orders; Transfer orders; Organization charts; Form-16; and two pay slips for every year for each organisation, to corroborate the work area/department/section.
  • NOC (No Objection Certificate) from the current employer, for candidates currently working in Govt/Public Sector Undertakings.
  • Pay-scale circular/matrix, for candidates currently working in Govt/PSUs, to verify a minimum of 2 years' service in the required pay scale of Rs. 60,000–1,80,000 or above (IDA pay scale of E-3 Grade or above of NTPC, effective from 01.01.2017) or equivalent scale.

How to Apply for NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted only in online mode, through NTPC's careers website. No other mode of application will be accepted.

Steps to Apply Online

  1. Log on to careers.ntpc.co.in, or visit the careers section at www.ntpc.co.in.
  2. Register with a valid, active email ID (NTPC will not be responsible for bounced emails sent to candidates).
  3. Fill in the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and experience details for the discipline being applied for.
  4. Upload all required documents as listed in the Documents Required section above.
  5. Pay the applicable application fee (General/EWS/OBC candidates only), either offline via the SBI pay-in-slip process, or online through Net Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card.
  6. After applying online, download the system-generated application slip bearing a unique application number, and retain a copy for future reference. No documents need to be sent by post.

Important Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • All qualifications must be full-time, from Universities/Institutions recognised and approved in India.
  • The category (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD) once filled in the online application form cannot be changed later, and no benefit of any other category will be admissible subsequently. Candidates claiming a particular category must possess the applicable year's valid EWS/OBC-NCL/SC/ST/Disability certificate, in the latest prescribed Government of India format, from the Competent Authority.
  • Depending on the requirement, the Company reserves the right to cancel, restrict, curtail, or increase the number of vacancies, at any stage, without further notice and without assigning any reason.
  • Posting shall be at any of the Stations/Projects/JVs/Subsidiaries of NTPC. All posts are transferable at the sole discretion of Management.
  • If it is detected at any stage of recruitment (or even after appointment) that a candidate does not fulfil the eligibility norms, has furnished incorrect/false information, or has suppressed any material fact, the candidature will stand automatically cancelled, and the services of an appointed candidate are liable to be terminated without notice. Canvassing in any form shall disqualify the candidate.
  • Any dispute arising out of this advertisement or an application submitted in response to it can be instituted only in Delhi, and courts/tribunals/forums in Delhi alone shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • In case of any ambiguity or dispute arising from interpretation in a version other than English, the English version will prevail.
  • It is mandatory that eligible candidates go through the full text of the advertisement and agree to all the conditions given, while applying. Any addendum/corrigendum/update relating to this recruitment will be published only on NTPC's official website.

  • Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply.

  • Application fee for all posts is ₹100.
  • However, all candidates must initially pay a processing fee of ₹500 per application, uniformly.
Post(s) Applied For Fee

Fee is payable only online through the Bharatkosh e-Payment gateway via Internet Banking, UPI, or Debit Cards (domestic). No other mode of payment (cash, cheque, draft, money order, IPO, etc.) is accepted. The processing fee is refunded in full to candidates exempted from the fee (women, SC/ST/PwBD, Ex-Servicemen) who appear in the written test/CBT; for all other candidates, ₹100 is deducted and the balance refunded, provided the candidate appears in the written test/CBT. Refund is not considered if a candidate fails to appear for the written test/CBT.

ISRO ICRB Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Written Test

A single objective-type paper of 150 minutes duration (with compensation time for PwBD candidates) will be conducted at 38 venues across India, including Agartala, Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Bhopal, Bhubaneshwar, Chandigarh/Mohali, Chennai, Dehradun, Delhi, Ernakulam, Gorakhpur, Gurugram, Guwahati, Hyderabad, Indore, Jaipur, Jammu, Jodhpur, Kanpur, Kavaratti, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mangaluru, Mumbai, Mysore, Nagpur, Patna, Port Blair, Pune, Raipur, Ranchi, Shillong, Tiruchirapalli, Thiruvananthapuram, Varanasi, Vijayawada, and Visakhapatnam.

Post Parts Questions / Marks Duration Qualifying Marks
Assistant / UDC (Post 1, 3 & 5) A: General English, B: Quantitative Aptitude, C: General Intelligence & Reasoning, D: General Knowledge 50 Q / 50 Marks each (200 total) 150 minutes 50% (UR), 40% (Reserved categories against notified reserved vacancies)
JPA / Stenographer (Post 2, 4 & 6) A: English Language & Comprehension, B: General Intelligence & Reasoning, C: Quantitative Aptitude & General Knowledge A: 100 Q/100 Marks, B: 50 Q/50 Marks, C: 50 Q/50 Marks (200 total) 150 minutes 50% (UR), 40% (Reserved categories against notified reserved vacancies)

Marking pattern: +1 for correct answer, -0.25 for wrong answer. No TA is paid for attending the written test.

Skill Test

Based on written test performance, candidates are shortlisted for the skill test in the ratio of 1:5 (maximum) to the category-wise number of vacancies.

Post Skill Test Components Passing Criteria
Assistant / UDC Computer Literacy Test (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint) 60% (UR), 50% (Reserved categories)
JPA / Stenographer Computer Literacy Test + Stenography Test (300 words @ 60 wpm shorthand, 30 minutes computer transcription) Computer Literacy: 60% (UR) / 50% (Reserved); Stenography: max 10% mistakes (UR) / max 12% mistakes (Reserved)

Final selection is based on marks scored in the written test, from among candidates who qualify in the skill test. In case of a tie, tie-breakers are applied in order: (a) marks in General Intelligence & Reasoning (Post 1,3,5) or English Language & Comprehension (Post 2,4,6); (b) date of birth, with the older candidate preferred.

ISRO ICRB Last Date to Apply Online

  • The online application process for ISRO ICRB Recruitment 2026 started on 27 July 2026 at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 20 August 2026 at 11:55 PM.
  • Candidates who meet the prescribed eligibility criteria are advised to complete the registration process well before the last date to avoid last-minute technical issues.
  • Applications are accepted online only through the official ISRO website. Applicants should ensure that all required documents, including their photograph, signature, and applicable certificates, are uploaded correctly before submitting the application.
  • The application fee must also be paid online on or before 20 August 2026 for the application to be considered complete.

Direct Link to Apply Online for ISRO ICRB Recruitment 2026

ISRO ICRB Recruitment 2026 How to Apply

  • Applications are accepted online only, through the ISRO website, between 27-07-2026 (10:00 AM) and 20-08-2026 (11:55 PM).
  • Candidates may apply for more than one post, subject to conditions. A candidate may apply for different posts under the same or different zones but cannot apply for the same post in different zones. Candidates applying for multiple posts must select the same written test centre.
  • Email ID and mobile number are mandatory in the online application; all hall tickets, call letters, and communications will be sent only via registered email/SMS, with no hard copies sent separately.
  • Candidates registered under the National Career Services (NCS) portal and meeting eligibility conditions may follow the same application process on the ISRO website.
  • Candidates must upload a recent colour passport-size photograph (not older than 6 months, .jpg/.jpeg, 20–50 KB, 200x230 pixels preferred) and signature (.jpg/.jpeg, 10–20 KB, 140x60 pixels preferred), along with SC/ST/Disability/Ex-servicemen certificates where applicable.
  • Applications not conforming to the notified requirements, or incomplete applications, will not be considered.

ISRO ICRB Recruitment 2026 Remuneration

  • Selected candidates will be appointed as Assistant / Junior Personal Assistant / Upper Division Clerk / Stenographer in Level 4 of the Pay Matrix.
  • Minimum basic pay: ₹25,500 per month.
  • Additional allowances: Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), and Transport Allowance as per extant Central Government rules.
  • Employees will be governed by the New Pension Scheme.
  • Other benefits: medical facilities for self and dependents, subsidised canteen, limited quarters facility (in lieu of HRA), Leave Travel Concession, Group Insurance, and House Building Advance, as admissible per Central Government orders.
Component Details
Pay Level Level 4 of Pay Matrix
Minimum Basic Pay ₹25,500 per month
Allowances DA, HRA, Transport Allowance
Pension New Pension Scheme
Other Benefits Medical facilities, subsidised canteen, limited quarters (in lieu of HRA), LTC, Group Insurance, House Building Advance

Important Instructions

  • Candidates employed under Central/State Government, PSUs, or Autonomous Bodies must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of the Skill Test. Failure to submit the original NOC will result in the candidate not being permitted to appear for the Skill Test, and TA will not be paid.
  • PwBD candidates applying for reserved posts must submit a self-attested Disability Certificate in the prescribed format, indicating percentage of disability (minimum 40% relevant disability required for reservation eligibility), issued by a duly constituted Medical Board.
  • OBC candidates must possess a valid OBC certificate (non-creamy layer, in the prescribed proforma) as on the last date of application. EWS candidates must possess a valid Income and Asset Certificate for financial year 2026–2027.
  • Candidates attending the Skill Test will be reimbursed second-class railway fare (to and fro, shortest route) from the city indicated in the application to the Skill Test venue. No TA is payable for the Written Test.
  • All original documents must be produced at the time of the Skill Test in support of details furnished online. False information will result in disqualification from the Skill Test, and TA will not be paid.
  • Answer keys will be published on the ISRO website within three working days of the written test. Objections, with valid justification, may be raised only through the designated link within 5 days of publication; objections received after this window or through any other mode will not be considered.
  • Appointees are liable to be posted or transferred to any Centre/Unit of the Department of Space/ISRO at any time, based on requirement. The number of vacancies indicated is provisional, and ISRO reserves the right to increase, decrease, or not fill the posts without assigning any reason. The posts are temporary but likely to continue.
  • Any court case or legal matter arising from this recruitment falls under Bangalore, Karnataka jurisdiction. Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification.
  • Candidates are advised NOT to take cognizance of any fake offer of appointment for jobs in ISRO.
  • In case of ambiguity between the Hindi and English versions of the notification, the English version shall be treated as final.

Graduation in any discipline from a recognized University, or any equivalent qualification recognized as such by the Central Government. Candidates in their final year/semester of graduation may also apply provisionally, subject to producing proof of having passed the graduation examination on or before 31.12.2026.

Matriculate Ex-servicemen who have obtained the Indian Army Special Certificate of Education, or the corresponding certificate in the Navy or Air Force, after completing not less than 15 years of service in the Armed Forces of the Union, are also eligible. Such certificates should be dated on or before 31.12.2026.

SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026 Reservation

  • 4% horizontal reservation is provided to Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), as per Section 34 of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, for categories including Blind/Low Vision, Deaf/Hard of Hearing, locomotor disabilities (one/both arms, one/both legs, cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid attack victims, muscular dystrophy, spinal deformity/injury), Autism Spectrum Disorder (mild), intellectual disability, specific learning disability, mental illness, and multiple disabilities.
  • 4.5% of total vacancies are reserved for Disabled Ex-Servicemen and dependents of servicemen killed in action, in addition to the 10% earmarked for Ex-Servicemen (a total of 14.50%). First priority in appointment goes to Disabled Ex-Servicemen, and second priority to dependents of defence personnel killed in action or severely disabled (over 50% disability attributable to defence services).
  • Reservation for PwBD/XS/DXS candidates is horizontal and is included within the vacancies of the various parent categories (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/GEN) to which the candidate belongs.
  • OBC vacancies are available only to candidates in the "Non-Creamy Layer"; OBC candidates in the "Creamy Layer" are not entitled to any OBC relaxation/reservation and must indicate their category as General.
  • Benefit of reservation under the EWS category requires an Income and Asset Certificate for financial year 2025-26, valid for 2026-27, issued by a Competent Authority on the Government of India format.

  4. Upload your scanned photograph, signature, left-hand thumb impression, and hand-written declaration as per the specified guidelines, and capture a live photograph via webcam or mobile phone.

SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Not more than one application should be submitted by a candidate. In case of multiple applications, only the last valid (completed) application will be retained, and the fee paid for other registrations will be forfeited.
  • Request for change or correction of any particulars, including category, once the application is submitted, will not be entertained under any circumstances.
  • Candidates are advised to apply well before the closing date to avoid last-minute connectivity issues; SBI will not be responsible for failure to submit an application due to heavy website traffic or reasons beyond its control.
  • Mobile phones, pagers, smart watches, calculators, or any other communication/electronic devices are not allowed inside the examination premises.
  • The Bank may capture thumb impressions or IRIS scans at various stages for biometric verification; any inconsistency may lead to rejection of candidature.
  • Candidates found using unfair means, impersonation, or misbehaviour during the examination may be disqualified, debarred from future Bank examinations, and held liable for criminal prosecution.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • No hard copy of the call letter (Preliminary/Main) or the "Acquaint Yourself" booklet will be sent by post; candidates must download these from the Bank's website.
  • Appointment of selected candidates is subject to being declared medically fit and satisfactory completion of Know Your Employee (KYE) formalities, as well as the Bank's service and conduct rules.
  • Any legal proceedings relating to this advertisement or an application can only be instituted in Mumbai; courts, tribunals, and forums at Mumbai alone have jurisdiction.
  • The role requires flair for marketing and customer calls, banking, advisory, and cross-selling duties, both inside and outside Bank premises, with possible extensive outdoor travel and flexible working hours/shifts.
  • Decisions of the Bank in all matters regarding eligibility, conduct of tests, and selection are final and binding on all candidates; no representation or correspondence will be entertained.
  • The Bank reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process entirely at any stage.
  • State Bank of India does not endorse, authorize, or associate with any external coaching platform, consultancy, individual, or digital channel claiming to provide guaranteed selection or insider guidance. Candidates must rely solely on information available on SBI's official career portal.

The Directorate General of Quality Assurance (DGQA), Department of Defence Production, Ministry of Defence, Government of India, has invited applications for Direct Recruitment to 07 Technician (Semi Skilled) and 07 Technician (Skilled) Group 'C', Non-Ministerial, Industrial posts vide Advertisement No. CQA(S)/2026/Tech(SS) & Tech(SK), published in Employment News, 8–14 August 2026. DGQA Technician Recruitment 2026 does not use an online application portal - eligible candidates must send a duly filled physical application by Registered or Speed Post to the Controllerate of Quality Assurance (Systems), Secunderabad.

Quick answers: DGQA is recruiting for 14 Technician posts (07 Skilled + 07 Semi Skilled) across six establishment codes in Secunderabad, Bengaluru, Jabalpur, and Chandigarh. Only Indian Nationals aged 18–27 years (as on the application closing date) with Matriculation + ITI/relevant trade qualification can apply. There is no online application; candidates must post their application by Registered/Speed Post. The closing date is 21 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News (28 days for candidates from specified remote/northeastern regions and island territories). Selection is through a Written Test followed by a Trade Test - there is no interview.
