Candidates must be between 18 and 27 years of age as on the application closing date. Date of birth must be as per the 10th/Matriculation certificate or a Birth Certificate issued by a competent authority - Aadhaar Card is not accepted as proof of date of birth.

Recruited candidates will be covered under the National Pension Scheme (NPS)/Unified Pension Scheme (UPS) as applicable.

DGQA Technician Application Fee 2026

No separate application fee is mentioned in the notification. However, every applicant must submit one self-addressed envelope (size 30cm x 12cm) affixed with a postal stamp of Rs. 55/- along with the application, for despatch of the admit card. The organisation will not be responsible for non-receipt of the admit card due to an incorrect or incomplete address on this envelope.

DGQA Technician Selection Process 2026

Selection is done through a Written Test followed by a Trade Test - there is no interview.

  • Written Test: Objective type, Multiple Choice Questions only; no negative marking for wrong answers; duration 90 minutes; 100 questions for 100 marks.
Part Subject Questions Marks
(i) General Intelligence and Reasoning 25 25
(ii) General Awareness 25 25
(iii) English Language and Comprehension 25 25
(iv) Numerical Aptitude 25 25
- Total 100 100

Question papers for Parts (i), (ii), and (iv) are set in English and Hindi; Part (iii) is in English only. Candidates are shortlisted for the Trade Test based on written test marks and category of reservation. The Trade Test carries 100 marks, with a minimum qualifying mark of 40. The final merit list is prepared post both tests, based on Trade and Establishment. In case of a tie, resolution is by (1) older date of birth ranked higher, then (2) higher marks in Numerical Aptitude, then Reasoning, then General Awareness.

How to Apply for DGQA Technician Recruitment 2026

DGQA Technician Recruitment 2026 has no apply-online option. The application must be sent physically by Registered or Speed Post only.

  1. Fill the application in the prescribed format (Appendix 'A'), typed in English on A4 size paper.
  2. Attach the Admit Card in the prescribed format - Appendix 'B' for Technician (Semi Skilled) or Appendix 'C' for Technician (Skilled) - submitted in duplicate.
  3. Affix one self-attested passport-size photo on the application form, and one self-attested photo on each of the two admit card copies (three photos total).
  4. Enclose a self-addressed envelope (30cm x 12cm) affixed with a postal stamp of Rs. 55/- for admit card despatch.
  5. Clearly superscribe the envelope: "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF [Technician (Semi Skilled) / Technician (Skilled)] AND CATEGORY [SC/ST/OBC/UR]".
  6. Candidates already working in Government Service or a Public Sector Undertaking must route their application through proper channel, with a No Objection Certificate from their Head of Office; applications without this NOC are summarily rejected without further communication.
  7. Send the complete application by Registered/Speed Post to: Controllerate of Quality Assurance (Systems), DGQA Technical Complex, Manovikas Nagar P.O., Secunderabad – 500009.

Applications received after the closing date, even due to postal delay, are rejected summarily and no correspondence is entertained.

NGEL Manager Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

A. Manager – RE (E-4 Grade) – 28 Posts

Qualification: Fulltime Graduate in Engineering (Electrical/ Electrical & Electronics/ Control & Instrumentation/ Civil/ Mechanical) with a minimum of 60% marks from a recognised University/Institution in India.

Experience Profile: Minimum 10 years of post-qualification executive experience in the Power Sector in a Govt Organization/Public Sector Undertaking/Private Organization (including training period, if any). Of this, at least 4 years of working experience should be in the following areas at Renewable Energy Developers having at least 50 MW or more of grid-connected Solar and/or Wind and/or BESS Project(s): Business Development, Engineering, Contracts & Procurement, Commercial, Project Management, Corporate Planning, or Strategy.

B. Manager – Finance (E-4 Grade) – 5 Posts

Qualification: CA/CMA (previously ICWA) qualified from an institute recognised by the appropriate statutory authority in India.

Experience Profile: Minimum 10 years of post-qualification executive experience (excluding articleship period and including training period, if any) in the area of Finance/Accounts in a Govt Organization/Public Sector Undertaking/Private Organization. Candidates with knowledge of SAP, MS Office and Data Analytics will be preferred; preference will also be given to candidates who have worked with an RE Developer company.

C. Manager – Land (E-4 Grade) – 1 Post

Qualification: Full Time PG Degree/PG Diploma/PG Programme in Rural Management/ Rural Development/ Displacement/ Resettlement/ Rehabilitation/ Community Development/ Local Governance/ Local Development/ Livelihoods/ Social Entrepreneurship/ Social Development/ Social Administration/ Sustainable Development/ Development Policy & Practice/ Development Studies, OR MSW, OR MBA, OR Graduate in Engineering, with a minimum of 60% marks from a recognised University/Institution in India.

Experience Profile: Minimum 10 years of post-qualification executive experience (including training period, if any) in land acquisition/land aggregation/land management in a Govt Organization/Public Sector Undertaking/Private Organization. Of this, at least 4 years of experience should be in land acquisition/aggregation/management for Renewable Energy developers having at least 50 MW or more of grid-connected Solar and/or Wind and/or BESS Project(s). Candidates with knowledge of SAP, MS Office and Data Analytics will be preferred.

Experience Norms for Govt/PSU Candidates (All Three Posts)

Candidates currently working in a Govt/Public Sector Undertaking and applying for any of the above E-4 level posts should have a minimum of 2 years' experience in the scale of Rs. 60,000–180,000 or above (IDA Pay Scale of E-3 Grade or above of DPE, effective from 01.01.2017) or an equivalent scale, out of the 10 years of post-qualification executive experience mentioned above (including training/trainee period, if any).

The medical fitness decision issued by the hospital is final and binding, and no relaxation in the prescribed health standards is allowed. Detailed medical norms are available on the NGEL website (www.ngel.in); applicants are advised to review these norms before applying.

All three posts - Manager – RE, Manager – Finance, and Manager – Land - are at the E-4 Grade level, carrying the IDA pay scale of Rs. 70,000 – 200,000/- (w.e.f. 01.01.2017). The notification does not specify additional allowances or gross salary figures beyond this pay scale.

Category Fee

The fee can be paid only in online mode through the SBI Collect Payment Gateway, using Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card, or UPI, within the online application form itself. The fee, once paid, will not be refunded under any circumstances; candidates are advised to verify their eligibility before paying the registration fee.

NGEL Manager Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

Post Upper Age Limit
Manager – RE, Manager – Finance, Manager – Land 40 years

  • OBC candidates: 3 years, where a vacancy is identified for the category
  • PwBD candidates: 10 years, where a vacancy is identified for the category
  • Ex-Servicemen: as per applicable Government guidelines

Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

NGEL Manager Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

To restrict the number of candidates for the selection process, if required, NGEL Management reserves the right to conduct a multistage selection process, which may comprise:

  • Application shortlisting/screening (based on qualification, percentage of marks, number of years of experience, etc.)
  • Written Test / Group Discussion / Interview, or a combination of Written Test, Group Discussion, and Interview

NGEL Management also reserves the right to raise the minimum eligibility standards or criteria as per requirement. Meeting the minimum eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement does not by itself entitle a candidate to be shortlisted or called for the Written Test/Group Discussion/Interview, or to be considered further in the selection process.

Documents Required for NGEL Manager Recruitment 2026

Candidates must upload clear, legible, self-attested copies of the following documents at the time of applying:

  • Class X/Matriculation passing certificate/mark sheet, and a valid Aadhaar Card and PAN Card, as proof of name and date of birth (name and DOB should match across all documents).
  • Engineering/CA/CMA/PG/MSW/MBA (as applicable to the post applied for) consolidated mark sheet/transcript or all-semester mark sheets clearly indicating the aggregate percentage of marks, and the passing certificate.
  • Marks conversion formula from the university/institute, for conversion of CGPA/CGPI/DGPA/CGI/CPI etc. into a percentage.
  • Documents related to any other qualifications (pass certificate and mark sheets), if applicable.
  • Caste/Disability certificate (for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD/EWS candidates), as applicable.
  • OBC-NCL certificate in the central format, valid for financial year 2026-27.
  • Current-year Income & Asset certificate for EWS candidates, valid for FY 2026-27 based on FY 2025-26 income.
  • Disability certificate as per the latest prescribed Central Government format, generated online through the Swalamban/UDID portal, clearly indicating the type and percentage of disability in line with the identified disability categories for the post.
  • Experience-related documents for each organisation, arranged chronologically starting from the current/most recent employer back to the first employer, which may include: Experience/Service Certificate; Offer of Appointment/Appointment Letter/Offer Letter with Joining Letter/Joining Order/Confirmation Letter/Absorption Letter/Order on Completion of Training/Relieving Letter (as applicable); two pay slips per year of service in each organisation; and Form 16 for the last three financial years.
  • Documents demonstrating position held/designation, work area, and nature of experience - such as Role Assignment Orders, Organization Charts, Transfer Orders, or Promotion Orders.

Incomplete, inadequately supported, or improperly arranged experience documents may result in the application not being considered during scrutiny and eligibility verification. Candidates from Govt Organizations/PSUs will also be required to produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of interview; if the NOC is not available at that stage, the candidate may be provisionally allowed to appear, subject to an undertaking to submit the NOC within a stipulated time or obtain proper relieving before joining NGEL, if selected.

How to Apply for NGEL Manager Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted only in online mode, through the Careers section of the official NGEL website (www.ngel.in). No other mode of application will be accepted.

Steps to Apply Online

  1. Visit the Careers section of www.ngel.in and locate the notification for Advertisement No. 03/26.
  2. Register with a valid, active email ID (this cannot be changed later; all further correspondence will be sent only via this email ID).
  3. Fill in the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and experience details for the post being applied for.
  4. Upload all required documents as listed in the Documents Required section above, in clear and legible format.
  5. Pay the applicable registration fee online (General/EWS/OBC candidates only) through the SBI Collect Payment Gateway using Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card, or UPI.
  6. After submitting the application, download the system-generated application slip bearing a unique form number, and retain a copy for future reference. No documents need to be sent by post.

In case of multiple applications submitted by a candidate for the same post, the application with the higher application sequence number will be considered.

Important Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • All qualifications must be from Universities/Institutions recognised and approved in India. SC, ST and PwBD candidates with passing marks are eligible to apply for the post.
  • The category (SC/ST/OBC/PwBD) once filled in the online application form cannot be changed later, and no benefit of any other category will be admissible subsequently. Candidates claiming a particular category must possess a valid EWS/OBC/SC/ST/Disability certificate, in the latest prescribed Government of India format, from the Competent Authority.
  • The Company reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process, or to restrict/curtail/increase the number of vacancies, at any stage, without further notice and without assigning any reason.
  • Posting can be at any of NGEL's Corporate Centre/Sites/Stations/Projects/JVs/Subsidiaries. All posts are transferable at the sole discretion of Management.
  • If it is detected at any stage of recruitment (or even after appointment) that a candidate does not fulfil the eligibility norms, has furnished incorrect/false information, or has suppressed any material fact, the candidature will stand automatically cancelled, and the services of an appointed candidate are liable to be terminated without notice. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate.
  • The age of superannuation in NTPC Green Energy Limited is 60 years. All appointments are governed by the applicable service rules and regulations of the Company, as amended from time to time.
  • Any dispute arising out of this advertisement or an application submitted in response to it can be instituted only in Delhi, and courts/tribunals/forums in Delhi alone shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • In case of any ambiguity or dispute arising from interpretation in a version other than English, the English version of the advertisement will prevail.
  • It is mandatory that eligible candidates go through the full text of the advertisement and agree to all the conditions given, while applying. Any addendum/corrigendum/update relating to this recruitment will be published only on the official NGEL website.

The Government of India, Ministry of Defence, ASC Centre (South), Bangalore has released an Employment Notice inviting applications for 62 civilian posts across nine trades. The Army Service Corps Centre (South) - commonly referred to as ASC Centre (South) - published this notification in the Employment News issue dated 15–21 August 2026. Interested and eligible candidates can apply through the offline (postal) mode as detailed below.

ASC Centre (South) is inviting applications for the following posts: Civilian Catering Instructor (CCI), Cook, MTS (Chowkidar), Civilian Motor Driver (CMD), Cleaner, Tradesman Mate (Labour), Fire Engine Driver (FED), Fireman, and Leading Fireman. A total of 62 vacancies are available across these nine posts, spread across multiple stations in India, including Bangalore, Pune, and several locations in Punjab, Rajasthan, Jammu & Kashmir, Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal, Sikkim, and the North East. Eligibility ranges from Matriculation with trade proficiency to Matriculation with a valid driving licence, depending on the post. The age limit is 18 to 25 years for most posts and 18 to 27 years for Civilian Motor Driver, with standard government relaxations for reserved categories, Ex-servicemen, and PWD candidates. Applications must be submitted only by post, in the prescribed proforma, within 21 days of the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News/Rozgar Samachar. There is no online application mode for this recruitment.

  • SC/ST/OBC candidates who apply against an unreserved post will not be given age relaxation or other concessions meant for SC/ST/OBC.
  • Departmental candidates with three years’ continuous service in Central Government: up to 40 years of age (45 years for SC/ST).

The crucial date for determining the age limit is the last date fixed for receipt of applications.

Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

ASC Centre (South) Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Selection to all Group C posts under this recruitment is made solely on the basis of marks obtained by candidates in the written test, subject to qualifying in the Skill/Physical/Practical test, as applicable to the post.

  1. Skill/Physical/Practical Test: All candidates are first examined for their technical trade skill and physical fitness (as applicable to the post). This test is qualifying in nature.
  2. Written Test: Only candidates who clear the technical trade and physical test are eligible to appear for the written test. The written test consists of four objective-type papers, conducted over a duration of 2 hours, with negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer.

Written Test Pattern

Part Subject No. of Questions Maximum Marks
Part I General Intelligence & Reasoning (Objective MCQ) 25 25
Part II General Awareness (Objective MCQ) 50 50
Part III General English (Objective MCQ) 50 50
Part IV Numerical Aptitude (Objective MCQ) 25 25

Total duration for all four parts combined is 2 hours. Question papers will be bilingual (English & Hindi), except for the General English paper, which will be in English only.

Skill/Physical/Practical tests and the written examination are scheduled to be conducted at ASC Centre (South), Bangalore (Karnataka) only. Requests for change of examination centre will not be entertained. No TA/DA is admissible for any stage of the selection process.

Documents Required for ASC Centre (South) Recruitment 2026

Candidates must submit self-attested legible copies of the following documents along with their application:

  • Aadhaar Card
  • Domicile certificate
  • Matriculation Pass Certificate
  • Mark sheet of Class X or Matriculation
  • Experience Certificate (where applicable to the post)
  • Proof of caste/category (SC/ST/OBC/PH/ESM/EWS) from competent authorities
  • Admit Card (in duplicate, as per the format given in the notification)
  • Two additional self-attested passport-size photographs, besides one pasted on the application form

How to Apply for ASC Centre (South) Recruitment 2026

This recruitment does not have an online application process. Applications must be submitted only by post, in the prescribed proforma given in the notification.

Steps to Apply Offline

  1. Download or note the application proforma (Appendix format) provided at the end of the official notification.
  2. Fill the application on plain paper, either typed or neatly handwritten, in English or Hindi.
  3. Paste one recent passport-size photograph (self-attested) on the form, and enclose two additional self-attested photographs separately (mobile printouts/selfies are not accepted).
  4. Attach self-attested copies of all required certificates and documents listed in the Documents section above.
  5. Enclose one self-addressed envelope duly affixed with the appropriate postal stamp.
  6. On the application cover envelope, write "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ____" in capital letters, along with the overall percentage of marks obtained in Matriculation/equivalent, written in the specified colour ink: Red ink for 50% or below, Blue ink for 51% to 60%, and Black ink for 61% and above.
  7. Send the completed application by post to: The Presiding Officer, Civilian Direct Recruitment Board, Civ CR, ASC Centre (South), Agram Post, Bangalore – 560007.

Candidates should apply for only one trade; applications from candidates found applying for more than one trade will be rejected. All correspondence, including despatch of call letters for the written test, will be through e-mail only; the physical copy of the call letter will be sent separately by post. Candidates must therefore ensure their functional mobile number and e-mail address are mentioned in the application.

Also read: DRDO ADA Project Assistant I Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 111 Posts

Important Instructions

  • Physically handicapped (PWD) candidates have no reserved vacancies in the following trades: CCI, Cook, MTS (Chowkidar), Cleaner, Labour, and Civil Motor Driver.
  • Aadhaar Card prepared below 10 years of age will not be accepted; Aadhaar and PAN must bear the applicant’s name exactly as per the School Certificate.
  • OBC, SC, ST, and EWS category candidates must submit legitimate certificates issued by the competent authority as prescribed under DoPT O.M. No. 36039/1/2019-Estt (Res) dated 31-01-2019.
  • SC/ST/OBC/EWS/ESM/PWD/MSP candidates have the right to compete for General/unreserved vacancies; in such cases, no concession or relaxation applicable to their category will be provided.
  • OBC candidates must submit an additional undertaking (Non-Creamy Layer declaration) in the format given in the notification (Appendix-IV).
  • Ex-servicemen (ESM) candidates must submit an Ex-servicemen certificate along with a self-attested copy of the Discharge Certificate and an Undertaking in the format given in the notification (Appendix-III).
  • Serving Defence personnel (Army/Navy/Air Force) and Defence Civilian Employees currently in service must enclose a "No Objection Certificate" (NOC) issued by their Record Office.
  • Persons already employed in Central/State Government or a PSU must apply through proper channel, along with a certificate from their establishment confirming no disciplinary action is pending and no objection to their release if selected.
  • Meeting the basic eligibility criteria does not automatically entitle a candidate to be called for the Skill/Physical/Practical and written test; shortlisting may be resorted to if the number of applications is large.
  • All selected candidates are liable for All India service and may be posted to Hard Areas, High Altitude Areas, Remote Locality Areas, or Field Areas. Selected candidates are advised to give a choice of three stations in order of preference; final posting will be subject to administrative requirements.
  • There is no provision for re-evaluation or re-checking of scores; no correspondence in this regard will be entertained.
  • The number of vacancies mentioned in the notification is provisional and can be changed by the Commandant, ASC Centre (South), if necessary. The recruitment process can also be cancelled, suspended, or terminated at any stage for administrative reasons.
  • Candidates are cautioned against unscrupulous elements offering assurance of appointment through illegal gratification; selection is made purely on merit through a transparent process.

What Is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job is any government job opportunity offered across India's central and state government departments - spanning all 28 states and 8 union territories. The term "Bharat" simply emphasises pan-India coverage: a Bharat Sarkari Job notification could originate from a central body like the SSC, UPSC, or Indian Railways, or from a state public service commission recruiting for state-level posts. Regardless of origin, these roles share the defining traits Indian aspirants seek - long-term job security, government pay scales, and statutory retirement benefits.

Sarkari Job vs Private Job

A sarkari job differs from private-sector employment in a few important ways: government positions are governed by service rules that protect against arbitrary termination, salaries follow Pay Commission recommendations rather than market negotiation, and employees are entitled to pension schemes (NPS or OPS depending on recruitment year), medical coverage under CGHS, and fixed working hours. Private jobs, by contrast, often offer higher starting pay in competitive fields but carry less structural job security.

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 कैसे भरें? (How to Apply Online)

आवेदन की चरणबद्ध प्रक्रिया

  1. संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना (Notification PDF) ध्यान से पढ़ें और अपनी पात्रता जांचें।
  2. वैध ईमेल आईडी और मोबाइल नंबर से पोर्टल पर पंजीकरण (Registration) करें।
  3. व्यक्तिगत विवरण, शैक्षणिक योग्यता, और आवश्यक दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें (फोटो, हस्ताक्षर, प्रमाणपत्र)।
  4. निर्धारित आवेदन शुल्क का ऑनलाइन भुगतान करें और भुगतान की रसीद सुरक्षित रखें।
  5. फॉर्म सबमिट करने से पहले सभी जानकारी की दोबारा जांच करें और फॉर्म का प्रिंटआउट अवश्य लें।

Documents Required for Sarkari Form

Typical documents needed: recent passport-size photograph (as per specified size/format), scanned signature, educational certificates and mark sheets, category certificate (if applicable), and a valid ID proof (Aadhaar/PAN).

Common Mistakes to Avoid While Applying

  • Submitting a photo or signature that doesn't match the specified pixel/size requirements.
  • Missing the last date due to server load - apply at least 2–3 days before deadline.
  • Entering a name or date of birth that doesn't match your certificates exactly.
  • Forgetting to download and save the final submitted form and payment receipt.

Selection Process for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026

There is no written examination for Anganwadi Worker and Helper posts. Selection is merit-based on academic qualifications. For Supervisor and CDPO posts, a written exam or interview may be conducted.

How to Apply for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Online

  • Register / Login: Create a new account using your mobile number and Aadhaar. If already registered, log in with your credentials.
  • Fill the application form: Enter personal details, educational qualification, address, and select your preferred district/ward. Ensure you apply only for a ward where you are a permanent resident.

  • Review and submit: Check all entries carefully before final submission. Download and print the application confirmation / acknowledgement slip for your records.

Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 – FAQ's

How to apply for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 online?

Visit your state's official WCD / ICDS portal (link provided in table above). Register with mobile & Aadhaar, fill the application form, upload documents (photo, 10th certificate, Aadhaar, domicile), and submit before the last date. Print the application acknowledgement slip after submission.

What is the eligibility for Anganwadi Worker 2026?

Candidates must have passed 10th or 12th standard from a recognized board. Age limit is 18–35 years (varies by state). Must be a permanent resident of the ward/village for which vacancy exists. Only female candidates are eligible for Worker and Helper posts.

What is the salary of Anganwadi Worker in 2026?

Anganwadi Worker receives a monthly honorarium of ₹10,000–₹20,000 depending on the state (Karnataka and TN are highest at ~₹14,000). Anganwadi Helper gets ₹5,000–₹7,000/month. The Central Government pays ₹4,500/month as base honorarium, and states add their own component on top.

Is there a written exam for Anganwadi jobs?

No, there is no written examination for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts. Selection is purely merit-based on academic qualification marks (10th / 12th percentage). For Supervisor / CDPO posts, a written exam or interview may be conducted depending on the state.

What is the age limit for Anganwadi Helper?

Age limit is 18 to 35 years as of 1st January 2026 in most states. SC/ST candidates get 5 years relaxation (maximum age 40). OBC candidates get 3 years relaxation (maximum age 38). PwD candidates get additional relaxation as per state rules.

What documents are required for Anganwadi job application?

Required documents: Aadhaar card, 10th/12th marksheet and certificate, domicile/residence certificate, caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC), passport-size photograph, scanned signature, and EWS/PwD certificate if applicable. Graduation certificate is needed for Supervisor post applications.

What is ICDS recruitment 2026?

ICDS stands for Integrated Child Development Services - the government programme under which Anganwadi centres operate nationwide. ICDS recruitment 2026 refers to hiring of Anganwadi Workers, Helpers, Supervisors, and CDPOs by state WCD departments under the Ministry of Women & Child Development (wcd.nic.in).

Is Anganwadi Worker a permanent government job?

Anganwadi Workers and Helpers are honorary workers, not regular government employees. They receive a fixed monthly honorarium (not salary) and are entitled to benefits like ESI, health insurance, and maternity benefits. Supervisors and CDPOs are regular government employees in most states and receive full pay & grade pay.

Can I apply for Anganwadi job from a different district?

No. Anganwadi Workers and Helpers must be permanent residents of the same ward/village/district where the vacancy exists. A domicile or residence certificate is mandatory. Applications from outside the specified locality are rejected. For Supervisor/CDPO posts, the same district residency rule generally applies.

Forest Department Posts List

The forest department offers a range of posts across different levels, from ground-level field roles to gazetted officer positions. Most current openings on this page are for Group C posts - Forest Guard, Forester, Beat Guard, and Field Guard - making this a common landing point for anyone searching forest department group c recruitment 2026.

  • Forest Guard - entry-level field post responsible for forest protection and anti-poaching patrols
  • Forester - supervises Forest Guards and manages a forest beat or range sub-unit
  • Forest Beat Officer - field-level post combining patrol, record-keeping, and community liaison duties; commonly searched as forest beat officer notification 2026
  • Range Forest Officer (RFO) - manages an entire forest range, includes administrative and enforcement responsibilities
  • Assistant Conservator of Forests (ACF) - gazetted officer post, typically recruited through state forest service exams

Eligibility for Forest Department Jobs 2026

Educational Qualification

  • Forest Guard / Forest Watcher / Field Guard: 10th or 12th pass from a recognized board

  • Range Forest Officer: Graduate degree, frequently in Science, Agriculture, or Forestry
  • ACF / IFS: Graduate degree in a relevant discipline (Botany, Zoology, Forestry, Agriculture, Veterinary Science, Engineering, or Environmental Science), followed by the respective state or UPSC exam

Age Limit & Relaxation

The general age limit for Forest Guard and Forester posts is usually 18–27 years, though this varies by state. Age relaxation is generally available for SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), PwBD candidates, and other reserved categories as per government norms.

Reservation & Age Relaxation for Ex-Servicemen

Most state forest departments reserve a fixed percentage of Forest Guard, Forester, and Beat Guard posts for ex-servicemen, in addition to SC, ST, OBC, and EWS reservations. Candidates applying for jobs for ex servicemen in forest department typically receive:

  • Additional age relaxation, usually 3–5 years beyond the general age cap (or as per length of military service)
  • Relaxed physical standards in several states
  • A reserved vacancy quota, separate from the general merit list

Exact quota percentages and relaxation norms differ by state, so always cross-check the specific notification before applying.

Physical Standards

Most Forest Guard and Forester posts require candidates to clear height, chest measurement (for male candidates), and a Physical Efficiency Test involving running, walking, or trekking - since the job involves regular field patrol duty in forest terrain.

Selection Process & Exam Pattern for Forest Officer & Forest Guard Posts

The selection process for forest department recruitment generally involves multiple stages, designed to test both academic knowledge and physical fitness given the field nature of the job.

Written Exam, PET/PST & Document Verification

  1. Written Examination - objective-type questions on General Knowledge, General Science, Reasoning, Mathematics, and sometimes Forestry/Environment-related topics
  2. Physical Efficiency Test (PET) / Physical Standard Test (PST) - running, walking/trekking distance, height and chest measurement
  3. Document Verification - verification of educational certificates, age proof, category certificates, and (where applicable) ex-servicemen discharge documents
  4. Medical Examination - fitness check before final appointment
  5. Final Merit List - based on combined written exam and PET/PST scores, as per each state's weightage formula

Two Types of No Exam Govt Jobs

No-exam recruitment in India falls into two patterns, and knowing which one a notification belongs to tells you exactly what to prepare for:

Type Typical Posts Who it's for How Selection Works
Fresher - no exam, usually no interview Apprentice, GDS, trainee 10th/12th/ITI/Diploma/Graduate pass Merit list prepared from academic marks
Experienced - no exam, interview-based Officer, manager, specialist, medical Professionals with relevant work experience Shortlisting based on qualification/experience, followed by a personal interview

How Recruitment Without Exam Works in Government Jobs

This section explains the different routes through which government departments fill vacancies without conducting a written competitive exam.

1. Direct Recruitment

Certain senior and specialised posts - such as Chairman, Member, and Secretary in Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) and State Public Service Commissions (PSCs) - are filled through direct recruitment based on eligibility criteria like qualifications, experience, and domain expertise, rather than a written exam. Similarly, some administrative posts in the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) may be filled through direct recruitment.

2. Sports Quota Recruitment

Government organisations such as Indian Railways, the Indian Army, and Public Sector Banks reserve a quota of posts for candidates with outstanding achievements in sports at the state, national, or international level. Eligible candidates can be appointed to posts like Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, and Clerk without going through the regular written exam.

3. Cultural Quota Recruitment

Indian Railways also recruits individuals with exceptional talent in arts, fine arts, music, or literature under the cultural quota for posts such as Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, and Assistant Loco Pilot.

4. Internal Promotions and Deputation

Government departments, including the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) and Indian Police Service (IPS), promote existing employees to higher posts based on performance, seniority, and experience - without requiring them to clear a fresh competitive exam. Ex-servicemen and defence personnel are also often considered for civilian government posts through deputation or reservation quotas, without a written exam.

5. Apprenticeships and Trainee Programmes

Railways, PSUs, and central organisations like DRDO and BEL regularly hire Act Apprentices, Trade Apprentices, and Project Trainees through merit lists based on academic marks - with no written entrance test.

6. Walk-in Interviews

Some government and PSU organisations directly call candidates for walk-in interviews based on their qualifications and experience, especially for technical, medical, and contractual roles.

Government Jobs Without Exam by Sector

This section breaks down no-exam opportunities by sector - banking and railways - which are among the most common areas where such recruitment occurs.

Bank Jobs Without Exam

While most public sector bank recruitment (PO, Clerk, SO) happens through IBPS or bank-specific written exams, some banks fill specific posts - such as Local Bank Officer and certain Specialist Officer roles - through direct recruitment, where the bank shortlists applications based on eligibility criteria and conducts an interview instead of a written test.

Railway Jobs Without Exam

Indian Railways and the various Railway Recruitment Boards/Cells (RRBs/RRCs) offer no-exam entry through:

  • Act Apprentices (selection via academic merit list)
  • Sports Quota posts (Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, Clerk)
  • Cultural Quota posts (Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, Assistant Loco Pilot)
  • Scouts and Guides Quota

Before You Apply: How to Spot Fake "No Exam" Job Offers

No-exam recruitment is the single biggest magnet for job fraud in India, because "direct joining, no exam" is exactly what scammers promise. Four rules protect you:

  1. No genuine government post is ever sold. Nobody - agent, "officer", consultancy - can arrange selection for money. The only payment in real recruitment is the application fee, paid on the official portal, typically a few hundred rupees.
  2. Verify the notification on the official domain. Every real notice lives on a .gov.in, .nic.in or official PSU domain. Every row in our list links to the post page where the official notification PDF and apply link are attached - if an offer you received isn't traceable to an official notice, treat it as fraud.
  3. No recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram DMs. Forwarded "joining letters" and interview calls demanding a deposit are scams, full stop.
  4. Cross-check suspicious notices against PIB Fact Check before sharing or paying anything.

How to Apply for Government Jobs Without Exam

  1. Open the post from the live list and read the official notification PDF - eligibility, age limits and fee are final there, not in any summary.
  2. Confirm you match the qualification and category requirements before paying any fee.
  3. Apply on the official portal linked in the notification; keep the registration number and fee receipt.
  4. For merit-list posts (GDS, apprentice), enter marks exactly as on your certificates - mismatches reject applications at verification.
  5. Track the post page for merit list / shortlist updates, or subscribe to WhatsApp/Telegram alerts so deadlines and results reach you automatically.

Government Jobs Without Exam - FAQs

1. Are there really government jobs without an exam?

Yes. Apprenticeship intakes, India Post GDS, sports and cultural quota posts, walk-in interviews and direct recruitment for experienced candidates are all filled without a written competitive exam. The live list at the top of this page shows every such notification currently open.

2. Which government jobs have no exam and no interview at all?

India Post GDS and Railway/PSU Act Apprentice selections use only a merit list of academic marks - there is no written test and no interview. Everything depends on your Class 10 (and ITI/diploma, where applicable) percentage.

3. What no-exam options exist for freshers after 10th, 12th or ITI?

Apprenticeships, GDS and trainee posts are the main fresher routes. Selection is a merit list prepared from academic marks, which is why these notifications attract very high application volumes despite no exam.

4. Can experienced professionals get a government job without an exam?

Yes. PSUs and autonomous bodies fill officer, manager and specialist posts by shortlisting candidates on qualification and experience, followed by a personal interview - no written test.

5. Are government jobs without exam permanent?

Often not. Apprenticeships are roughly one-year training engagements with a stipend, and many walk-in posts are contractual with fixed tenure. Direct-recruitment posts can be regular - the notification states the nature of each post, so check before applying.

6. Are there bank jobs without an exam?

A few. Some banks fill specialist and local officer posts through shortlisting plus interview. Bank apprenticeship drives vary - some are merit-based while others include an online test - so read each notification's selection clause.

7. Are there railway jobs without an exam?

Yes: Act Apprentice intakes (merit list), sports quota, cultural quota and Scouts & Guides quota. Apprentice intakes are large; the quota routes are small zonal recruitments with their own assessment process.

8. Is India Post GDS really without an exam?

Yes - selection is an online merit list generated from Class 10 marks, with no exam and no interview. Because of that, GDS is heavily targeted by paid-selection scams; apply only through the official GDS portal.

9. How do I identify fake "no exam" job offers?

No genuine government post is sold, fees are paid only on official portals, and no recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram messages. Verify every offer against the official notification on a government or PSU domain - if it isn't there, it's fraud.

10. How often is this list updated?

Daily. New notifications are added as they release, and every listing is removed automatically after its last date, so the list only ever shows posts you can still apply for.

Govt Jobs for Law Graduates - Eligibility (LLB, LLM, BL)

Eligibility varies by post, but the core requirement for almost every government law job is a recognised law degree. Senior and specialised roles add experience, an LLM, or Bar enrolment on top.

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor of Law (BL) / LLB (Legum Baccalaureus): the baseline qualification for most legal and law officer posts.
  • LLM (Master of Laws): required for senior legal officer, faculty, and some advisory positions.
  • Integrated 5-year degrees - BA LLB, BBA LLB, BCom LLB - are accepted wherever an LLB is required.

The degree must be from a university recognised by the Bar Council of India.

Bar Council Enrolment & AIBE

For litigation, prosecutor, and standing-counsel roles you generally need to be enrolled as an advocate with a State Bar Council, and many positions ask for the All India Bar Examination (AIBE) Certificate of Practice issued by the Bar Council of India. Purely advisory or research posts (Law Clerk, Research Fellow, Legal Consultant) often do not require enrolment.

Age Limit & Relaxations

The upper age limit is typically 30 to 40 years for the general category, depending on the post and recruiter. Statutory relaxations apply: usually 3 years for OBC, 5 years for SC/ST, and additional relaxation for PwD and ex-servicemen candidates. Always confirm the exact limit and cut-off date in the official notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

Salary & Pay Scale for Government Law Jobs

Pay depends on the organisation and grade. Officer-level legal posts under the 7th Pay Commission generally fall in Pay Levels 10 to 12, with a monthly salary roughly between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500, plus Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, and other benefits. PSU legal officers are paid on IDA scales, which can be higher at entry grade.

Types of Law Officer / Legal Posts in Government Sector

  • Judicial Services - Civil Judge (Junior Division), Additional District Judge, High Court Judge, recruited via State Judicial Service Exams (PCS-J)
  • Law Officer / Legal Officer - Roles in public sector banks (IBPS SO Law), insurance companies (LIC AAO Legal), regulatory bodies (SEBI Grade A Legal), and PSUs (Coal India, NTPC, GAIL Legal)
  • Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor - Administrative legal support roles in ministries, universities, and district courts
  • Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO) - Prosecution roles recruited through State PSCs, requiring LLB and often a minimum years of practice

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, ADJ, High Court Judge)

Judicial Services is the most prestigious and highest-paying career path for LLB graduates. Recruitment happens through State Public Service Commissions (e.g., RPSC, UPPSC, MPPSC) via a three-stage exam: Preliminary, Mains, and Interview. Civil Judge posts typically require 0-3 years of practice depending on the state, while some states allow fresh LLB graduates to apply directly.

Law Officer / Legal Officer (Banks, PSU, Insurance)

Public sector banks and insurance companies recruit Law Officers through specialist officer (SO) exams. These posts require only an LLB degree (AIBE not mandatory) and offer competitive pay scales under the 7th Pay Commission equivalent structure, along with allowances.

Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor Posts

These are typically Group B/C administrative-legal posts in ministries, universities, and PSU legal departments, requiring an LLB degree and sometimes relevant drafting/litigation experience.

Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO)

APO recruitment is conducted by State PSCs (e.g., RPSC Assistant Prosecution Officer) and requires an LLB degree, enrollment as an advocate, and in most states, a minimum period of practice (often 3 years).

Selection Process for Law Govt Jobs

The selection process differs by post but commonly includes:

  1. Written examination - testing legal knowledge, aptitude, and general awareness (for judicial services and most exam-based posts).
  2. Interview / viva-voce - assessing legal reasoning and suitability.
  3. Document verification - degree, Bar enrolment, AIBE, age, and category certificates.

Advisory and consultant posts are often filled by shortlisting and interview alone, without a written exam.

  5. Upload the required documents and photograph.
  6. Pay the application fee (if any) and submit before the last date.

Law Govt Jobs FAQ's

What are the latest law govt jobs in 2026?

Current law government jobs in 2026 include Law Officer, Legal Officer, Assistant Prosecution Officer, Judicial Service, and Legal Adviser posts across High Courts, PSUs, public sector banks, and central/state departments. The table above is updated daily with vacancy count, last date, and the official notification link.

Which departments hire LLB and law graduates?

High Courts and District Courts, the Ministry of Law and Justice, UPSC, State Public Service Commissions, public sector banks, PSUs, insurance companies, and regulatory bodies regularly recruit law graduates for legal and judicial roles.

What is the eligibility for government law jobs?

Most posts require a Bachelor of Law (LLB/BL) from a recognised university; senior roles may require LLM and experience. Litigation and prosecutor posts usually require enrolment with a State Bar Council and, often, the AIBE certificate.

What is the salary of a Law Officer in the government sector?

A government Law Officer or Legal Officer typically earns between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500 per month under the 7th Pay Commission, depending on the organisation, plus DA, HRA, and allowances. PSU legal officers draw IDA-scale pay.

Can a fresher LLB graduate get a government job?

Yes. Freshers can apply for Civil Judge (Junior Division) judicial-service exams, Law Clerk and Research Fellow posts in High Courts, and trainee legal roles. Some PSU and bank Law Officer posts require a few years of post-enrolment experience.

How can I apply for law officer vacancies in central government?

Open the post in the table above, read the official notification, register on the recruiter's portal, fill in the application with your LLB and enrolment details, pay the fee, and submit before the last date.

What is the difference between Judicial Services and Law Officer posts

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, via state judiciary exams) places you on the bench as a judge. Law Officer/Legal Officer posts are departmental legal-counsel roles in PSUs, banks, and ministries - advisory and litigation support, recruited by interview or written test.

Is there an age limit for govt law jobs?

Most posts set the upper age at 30 to 40 years for the general category, with statutory relaxations for OBC, SC/ST, and PwD candidates. Check each notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

The Staff Selection Commission released the SSC CHSL Tier 2 Cut Off 2025-26 on 17th August 2026 along with the First Round of Tentative Allocation result and the final merit list PDF on the official website, ssc.gov.in. The Tier 2 exam was held on 10th April 2026, and the cut off has been decided based on the Computer Knowledge Test (CKT) qualifying marks, exam difficulty, number of candidates, and post-wise vacancies. This article covers the qualifying cut off, department-wise and post-wise final cut off marks, previous year trends, and the factors that decide the SSC CHSL cut off every year.

Direct Link to Check SSC CHSL Tier 2 Cut Off 2026

SSC CHSL Tier 2 Cut Off 2026: Computer Knowledge Test (CKT) Qualifying Marks

The Computer Knowledge Test (CKT), out of 45 marks, is the qualifying-stage cut off for Tier 2. Candidates must clear this stage before their Tier 1 + Tier 2 combined score is considered for department-wise allocation. The typing test (for LDC/JSA posts) and the Data Entry Skill Test, or DEST (for DEO/DEO Grade A posts), remain qualifying in nature and are assessed on a maximum-error basis rather than marks.

How to Check SSC CHSL Tier 2 Cut Off 2026

  1. Visit the official SSC website, ssc.gov.in.
  2. Click on the "Result" section on the homepage.
  3. Look for the link titled "SSC CHSL Tier-II Result / Cut Off 2025-26" or the FRTA (Final Result and Tentative Allocation) notice.
  4. Open the category-wise and department-wise cut off PDF.
  5. Use Ctrl+F (or Cmd+F) to search your roll number or check the marks table against your department/post code.
  6. Download and save the PDF for future reference.

Also Read: SSC CHSL 2025 FRTA Result

Factors Affecting SSC CHSL Tier 2 Cut Off 2026

  • Number of candidates who appeared: Higher turnout in Tier 2 generally pushes cut off marks up.
  • Difficulty level of the Tier 2 paper: An easier Computer Knowledge Test paper tends to raise the qualifying cut off, while a tougher paper lowers it.
  • Number of vacancies per post and department: Departments and posts with fewer seats usually see higher cut off marks due to tighter competition.
  • Category-wise reservation: Cut off marks vary significantly by category (UR, OBC, EWS, SC, ST, ESM, OH, HH, VH, PwD-Others) as per government reservation norms.
  • Previous year cut off trends: SSC's cut off pattern from prior cycles is a useful reference, though it is not a guarantee of the current year's figure.
  • Tier 1 performance of the candidate pool: Since final allocation combines Tier 1 and Tier 2 performance, strong Tier 1 scores among qualifiers can influence the final cut off.

AFCAT 2 Answer Key 2026: The Indian Air Force (IAF) has officially released the provisional answer key along with candidate response sheets for the Air Force Common Admission Test (AFCAT 02/2026). This recruitment drive is being conducted to fill a total of 379 vacancies for Flying and Ground Duty (Technical and Non-Technical) branches under Advertisement Number AFCAT 02/2026. Candidates who appeared for the written examination held on 8 August 2026 can now check their response sheets. The online objection portal was activated on 11 August 2026 at 11:00 AM, and candidates can submit challenges against any discrepancies until the objection window closes.

Reviewing your response sheet alongside the provisional answer key is an important step to estimate your tentative raw score and evaluate your performance. Candidates who find any discrepancies or incorrect official answers are advised to raise objections through the candidate portal before the deadline, as challenges will not be accepted after the cutoff date.

  3. Enter your registered Email ID, Password, and Captcha Code.
  4. Click on the Answer Key / Response Sheet tab on the candidate dashboard.
  5. View your attempted answers along with the official correct key.
  6. Download the PDF for your reference and future record.

Important Instructions for AFCAT Answer Key 2026

  • Objections must be submitted only through the official candidate portal within the active objection window.
  • No objections will be entertained after the objection window closes.
  • The final answer key, released after reviewing all objections, will be used for the actual result and merit calculation.
  • Keep a downloaded copy of your response sheet and answer key for future reference.

  6. Submit the application before the closing date; applications cannot be withdrawn or edited after submission

ITD MP&CG Canteen Attendant Eligibility Criteria / Qualification

Who Can Apply

Only Indian citizens can apply for the post of Canteen Attendant.

Educational Qualification

Candidates must have passed Matriculation (10th Standard) or an equivalent examination from any recognized board, on or before the cut-off date of 31-08-2026. Candidates who can prove by documentary evidence that the result of the qualifying examination was declared on or before the cut-off date will also be considered eligible; mere processing of the result by the Board by the cut-off date does not fulfil the requirement. Candidates possessing an equivalent educational qualification must produce the relevant Equivalence Certificate at the time of Document Verification. Candidates with a higher qualification may also apply.

Documents Required to be Submitted

  • Matriculation (10th Standard) or equivalent certificate
  • Community/Caste Certificate, if applicable - EWS, OBC, SC and ST (the EWS certificate must be issued by an officer not below the rank of Tehsildar)
  • Document in support of age relaxation claimed as Ex-Servicemen/Central Government Employee, if applicable
  • Certificate in support of PwBD status, if applicable
  • Passport-size photograph (taken not before 3 months from the date of the notification, with the full face visible, looking straight ahead, plain background, and without cap, mask, glasses/spectacles or earphones/headphones)
  • Scanned signature in JPEG/JPG format (thumb impression is allowed in place of signature for PwD/PwBD candidates with blindness and low vision)
  • Aadhaar card (or Aadhaar Authentication form in the absence of Aadhaar)

Incomplete applications, or applications submitted without a proper photograph, signature, valid photo ID (Aadhaar card, PAN card, Passport, Driving Licence, Voter ID card, or any other photo-bearing ID issued by the Central/State Government), or relevant certificates/documents, shall be summarily rejected.

Duties of Canteen Attendant

  • Preparing tea/coffee/juice etc. for users
  • Serving tea/coffee/biscuits etc. in official meetings
  • Providing regular room service to officers/staff
  • Collecting used cups/plates and utensils from within the canteen premises and from the rooms of senior officers after official meetings
  • Cleaning crockery/cutlery/utensils in three stages - running normal water, hot detergent water, and potassium permanganate solution
  • Sweeping and washing the floor area
  • Cleaning/dusting tables, chairs and other canteen furniture
  • Cleaning slabs and the area where food is cooked
  • Any other additional duty allotted by the Canteen in-charge

ITD MP&CG Canteen Attendant Age Limit

Candidates must be between 18 and 25 years of age as on 31-08-2026, i.e., they must have been born not earlier than 01-09-2001 and not later than 31-08-2008. This crucial date for determining age limit and educational qualification is fixed in accordance with the Income Tax Department, Non-Statutory Departmental Canteens (Group C posts) Recruitment Rules, 2015 (notification dated 18-11-2015). Only the date of birth recorded in the Matriculation/SSC or equivalent certificate will be accepted as proof of age, and no subsequent request for change will be considered.

Central Government Civilian Employees (with not less than 3 years regular and continuous service as on the closing date) Up to 40 years of age

Age relaxation is not admissible to sons, daughters and dependents of Ex-Servicemen.

ITD MP&CG Canteen Attendant Application Fee

There is no application fee for any category of candidates for this recruitment.

ITD MP&CG Canteen Attendant Salary

Post Basic Pay (7th CPC) Pay Level Pay Matrix Range
Canteen Attendant ₹18,000 Pay Level-1 ₹18,000–56,900

Selected candidates will be on probation for a period of 2 years, or such period as per the extant instructions of the Government of India.

ITD MP&CG Canteen Attendant Selection Process

Subject to fulfilling the eligibility criteria, applications will be scrutinized and suitable candidates shortlisted for further selection, comprising Scrutiny/Shortlisting, a Written Examination, and a Skill Test. Candidates may also be required to undergo a proficiency/practical test if further required.

Stage-1: Scrutiny and Shortlisting

280 candidates (40 eligible applications against each vacancy) will be shortlisted out of all eligible applications received, based on the percentage of total marks obtained in Matriculation (10th Standard) or the equivalent exam, for the next round - the objective-type written examination.

In case of a tie based on percentage of marks, the following criteria will be applied in sequence: (1) the candidate older in age as on the last date of receipt of application will be placed higher in merit; (2) if candidates have equal marks/percentage and the same date of birth, all such candidates will be allowed to appear in the written examination, irrespective of the prescribed shortlisting limit.

Stage-2: Objective-Type Written Examination

Subject Number of Questions
English Comprehension 10
Hindi Comprehension 10
Food and Nutrition 10
Quantitative Aptitude 5
Hygiene and Cleanliness 5
Total 40 questions, 1 mark each

The written examination is of 30 minutes' duration (40 minutes for candidates eligible for scribe assistance). One mark is awarded for each correct answer, and one-fourth (0.25) mark is deducted for each incorrect answer. The standard of questions is of matriculation level. Question papers will be set in Hindi and English only; in case of any discrepancy between the two versions, the English version will prevail. There is no provision for re-evaluation or rechecking of scores, and the written examination will be held only in Bhopal, M.P. - no request for change of venue will be entertained. No Travelling Allowance is paid to shortlisted candidates for attending the written examination. Success in the written examination confers no automatic right to appointment.

Tie-breaker for the Written Examination

  1. Older candidate in age as on the last date of application
  2. Candidate with more marks secured in Food and Nutrition
  3. Candidate with more marks secured in Hygiene and Cleanliness

Stage-3: Skill Test

70 candidates (10 eligible candidates against each vacancy) will be shortlisted for the Skill Test, which will be conducted at Bhopal (M.P.) only. The Skill Test carries a total of 60 marks and evaluates the candidate's proficiency in duties commensurate with the post of Canteen Attendant, including preparation of beverages, basic food handling skills, preparation techniques, presentation, hygiene, and cleanliness.

Final Result

The final merit list will be prepared based on the combined performance of candidates in the written examination and skill test (score out of 100), and 07 candidates will be selected strictly on merit against the available category-wise vacancies. The final result will be displayed on the Notice Board of the Income Tax Department, O/o the Principal Chief Commissioner of Income Tax, MP&CG, Aayakar Bhavan, 47, Arera Hills, Bhopal 462011, and on the regional website https://incometaxmpcg.gov.in.

Document Verification

Document Verification (DV) will be conducted after declaration of the final result. Candidates must produce the relevant original certificates mentioned/submitted in the online application form, failing which their candidature will be cancelled. A waiting list will be maintained, and the next eligible candidate(s) in order of merit will be considered for appointment if a selected candidate fails to join, declines the offer, or is found ineligible at any stage.

Compensatory Time and Scribe Assistance

Scribe assistance is provided to PwD candidates in pursuance of the relevant OMs issued by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities. For persons with benchmark disabilities (PwBD) in the category of blindness or locomotor disability (both arms affected), scribe facility is provided if desired, along with 10 minutes of compensatory time. Scribe facility is also available to PwD candidates with disability less than 40% who have difficulty in writing, on production of a certificate from a Chief Medical Officer/Civil Surgeon/Medical Superintendent of a Government healthcare institution. This facility must be opted for and indicated in the online application form; requests made later will not be entertained. Eligible candidates who do not avail of a scribe are also given 10 minutes of compensatory time, on production of the prescribed certificate.

Post-Selection Requirements

Selected candidates shall be subjected to Medical Fitness, Verification of Character Antecedents/Police Verification. Selected candidates are liable to be posted anywhere under the jurisdiction of the Principal Chief Commissioner of Income Tax, Madhya Pradesh & Chhattisgarh.

How to Apply for ITD MP&CG Canteen Attendant Recruitment 2026

ITD MP&CG Canteen Attendant Apply Online – Steps

  1. Visit the regional website: https://incometaxmpcg.gov.in
  2. Go through the notification, Annexure-I, instructions to candidates, and vacancy positions carefully before filling up the application form.
  3. Fill the online application form completely and correctly.
  4. Upload a proper photograph (as per the specified format), scanned signature, valid photo ID, and relevant certificates/documents.
  5. Submit the application online on or before 31-08-2026 (23:00 hrs). One candidate should apply only once - multiple applications by the same candidate will result in summary rejection of all such applications.

Applications received in any form other than online mode - including Post, Fax, Email, or by hand - will not be entertained by the Department. Eligible candidates will be called for the tests/verification, and the date and venue will be intimated to them in due course by the authorized officer.

Important Instructions

  • Candidates already employed in the Central Government, State Government or a PSU should submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their present employer, and the same should be mentioned in the application.
  • Any form of canvassing by a candidate will render their candidature liable to be summarily rejected at any stage of the recruitment process.
  • The Pr. Chief Commissioner of Income Tax, MP&CG, has the right to cancel the recruitment process at any stage without assigning any reason, and to accept or reject the candidature of any applicant.
  • In the event of any tie (other than those specifically addressed above), the decision of the Pr. Chief Commissioner of Income Tax MP&CG (CCA) shall be final.
  • The Department reserves the right to change the last date for submission of application, publishing of shortlisted candidates for written examination, date of written examination/skill test, or publication of final result, if required.
  • Candidates' admission at all stages of the examination is purely provisional, subject to satisfying the prescribed eligibility conditions. If, on verification at any time before or after the written examination, it is found that a candidate does not fulfil any eligibility condition, their candidature will be cancelled.
  • The crucial date for claiming SC/ST/OBC/PwBD status or any other benefit (reservation, age relaxation, etc.), where not specified otherwise, is the closing date for receipt of online applications, i.e., 31-08-2026.
  • A person seeking appointment on the basis of OBC reservation must ensure they do not fall in the creamy layer on the cut-off date.
  • A person seeking appointment on the basis of EWS reservation must possess an Income & Asset certificate valid for the financial year 2026-2027, issued on the basis of income for financial year 2025-26, in accordance with DoP&T OM No. 36039/1/2019-Estt (Res) dated 31-01-2019.
  • Candidates are cautioned that they will be debarred from the examination if they fraudulently claim SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD/ESM status or avail any other benefit. Candidature will remain provisional till the veracity of relevant documents is verified.

The Department may report the matter to Police/Investigating Agencies and take appropriate action, including examination by forensic experts. Any dispute regarding this recruitment will be subject to Bhopal jurisdiction, and the decision of the Department on all related matters will be final and binding.
  • For any difficulty in filling the online application form, or for correspondence/queries relating to the recruitment process, candidates may contact through the official e-mail ID: [email protected]. Any communication issued through this e-mail ID shall be treated as official communication for all purposes.
  • Any corrigendum issued on this recruitment notification will be published only on the Department's website. Candidates are advised to visit https://incometaxmpcg.gov.in from time to time for updates and information.

Engineers India Limited (EIL) Associate Modellers Recruitment 2026 Notification has been released under Advt. No. HRD/Rectt./Advt./2026-27/06 for the engagement of experienced candidates as Associate Modellers Group II on a fixed-term basis. A total of 22 vacancies have been announced across Instrumentation, Piping, EWS (Safety), Structural, Civil, and Equipment disciplines.

Candidates with a Diploma or B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc. (Engg.) qualification along with the prescribed relevant post-qualification experience in S3D/E3D/CADMATIC or related software are eligible to apply. The online application process for EIL Associate Modellers Recruitment 2026 has started on 7 August 2026 and will remain open until 21 August 2026. The upper age limit is 33 years as on 31 July 2026, subject to applicable age relaxations.

Candidates can check the official notification details and apply online through the official EIL website at www.engineersindia.com.

Candidates must meet the educational qualification and relevant experience prescribed for the position code they are applying to, as on the cut-off date of 31 July 2026.

  • Coverage under the company's GPAI Scheme, as per company policy

Only candidates meeting the eligibility requirements in full will proceed further. The selection process will be conducted at EIL's Delhi, Gurugram, Chennai, Kolkata and Vadodara offices for position codes A1 to F2. Candidates must report at 08:00 AM; the exact date and venue will be intimated separately by email. Depending on the number of candidates, the process may extend up to 08:00 PM and, if required, continue the next day, in which case candidates must arrange their own stay. Only candidates who have registered online and report with a printout bearing a valid registration number will be considered.

How to Apply for EIL Associate Modellers Recruitment 2026

EIL Associate Modellers Apply Online - Steps

  1. Visit the career link on the EIL website: www.engineersindia.com and complete the online registration.
  2. Read all instructions given on the website carefully before proceeding.
  3. Fill in the online form with correct details. Round off percentage of marks to the lower whole number (e.g., 60.9% becomes 60%) and CGPA to the lower decimal (e.g., 6.95 becomes 6.9).
  4. Keep scanned copies ready before starting registration: a recent passport-size colour photograph (JPG/JPEG, up to 75 KB) and a signature (JPG/JPEG, up to 25 KB).
  5. There is no need to post a printed application. Instead, take 6 printouts of the completed online application form, affix a colour photograph on each, and carry them to the selection process.
  6. Note that the cut-off date for post-qualification relevant experience and upper age limit is 31 July 2026.

A candidate can apply for only one position under this advertisement; if multiple applications are submitted, the latest one is considered final and older ones are rejected without notice.

Documents Required at the Time of Selection

  • Valid photo ID issued by the Government of India (Driving Licence/PAN Card/Passport/Voter ID/Aadhar Card) - original

  • Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets (Matriculation/Class X/HSC/Degree/Post-Graduation) - original
  • Proof of norms used to convert CGPA/OGPA/CPI to percentage, where applicable
  • Experience certificates for all declared experience, showing date of joining, date of separation and nature of work - original
  • Supporting documents such as offer letter, confirmation order, pay slips, PF statement, ESI card and bank statement, if demanded
  • SC/ST, OBC (NCL), EWS or Disability certificate in the prescribed format, if applicable - original
  • Discharge certificate and related proforma for Ex-Servicemen, if applicable
  • No Objection Certificate for candidates currently working in/under a Central/State/Autonomous Body, if applicable

Candidates unable to produce a required original document to meet eligibility will not be considered for further selection.

ITBP CAPF MOSB Medical Officer Eligibility Criteria / Qualification

Qualification for Super Specialist Medical Officers (Second-in-Command)

  • A graduate degree in Medicine (M.B.B.S.) or equivalent from a recognized university/institution included in the first schedule to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956.
  • Enrolled in any State Medical Register maintained under the Act.
  • Completed compulsory rotating internship.
  • Post Graduate Degree or Diploma in the related specialty mentioned in Section 'A' or Section 'B' in Schedule I to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 (102 of 1956), or equivalent.
  • Doctorate of Medicine (DM) or Magister Chirurgiae (M.Ch.) or equivalent, with three years' experience in the concerned Super-Specialty after obtaining the first postgraduate degree (Senior Residency period will also be counted towards experience).
  • Must have permanent registration from MCI/NMC/State Medical Council before appointment.

Qualification for Specialist Medical Officers (Deputy Commandant)

  • A recognized medical qualification of Allopathic system of medicine included in the first or second schedule or Part-II of the third schedule (other than licentiate qualification) to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956. Holders of qualifications in Part-II of the third schedule must also fulfil the conditions in Sub-Section (3) of Section 13 of the Act. Permanent registration from MCI/NMC/State Medical Council is required before appointment in any CAPF/AR.
  • Completion of compulsory rotating internship.
  • Post Graduate (PG) Degree/Diploma in the concerned specialty mentioned in Section 'A' or Section 'B' in Schedule-I, or equivalent, along with one and a half years' experience in the concerned speciality after obtaining the PG Degree, or two and a half years' experience after obtaining the PG Diploma.

Qualification for Medical Officers (Assistant Commandant)

  • A recognized medical qualification of allopathic system of medicine included in the first or second schedule or Part-II of the third schedule (other than licentiate qualification) to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956; Part-II third schedule holders must also fulfil the conditions in Sub-Section (3) of Section 13.
  • Permanent registration from any MCI/NMC/State Medical Council before appointment in any CAPF/AR.
  • Completion of compulsory rotating internship. Candidates undergoing rotating internship are eligible to apply and appear for the interview, provided that, if selected, they satisfactorily complete the compulsory internship before appointment.
