In addition to basic pay, officers are entitled to Non-Practicing Allowance, Dearness Allowance, Transport Allowance, House Rent Allowance and other allowances admissible under Central Government orders/provisions, as amended from time to time. No Post Graduate allowance is admissible, since a Post Graduate degree/diploma (or graduate degree/diploma in a particular field of specialization, as applicable) is the basic essential qualification for the post.

Promotional Avenues – Dynamic Assured Career Progression (DACP) Scheme

A Dynamic Assured Career Progression (DACP) Scheme grants time-scale financial upgradation to Medical Officers in CAPFs & AR without linkage to vacancy, based on years of regular service in each pay level. Broadly:

  • Medical Officers (Assistant Commandant): progress through Level-10 → Level-11 (4 years) → Level-12 (5 years) → Level-13 (4 years) → Level-13-A (3 years) → Level-14 (4 years, along with 20 years of regular service), with corresponding ranks from Deputy Commandant up to Commandant.
  • Specialist Medical Officers (Deputy Commandant): progress through Level-11 → Level-12 (2 years) → Level-13 (4 years) → Level-13-A (3 years) → Level-14 (4 years), with corresponding ranks from Second-in-Command up to Commandant.
  • Super Specialist Medical Officers (Second-in-Command): progress through Level-12 → Level-13 (4 years) → Level-13-A (3 years) → Level-14 (4 years), with corresponding ranks up to Commandant.

Promotion from the rank of Commandant to DIG (Medical) and IG (Medical) for Medical Officers and Specialist Medical Officers is by selection against sanctioned vacancy through a combined seniority list.

Provision for PG Course

An officer can apply for the PG entrance examination on completion of 5 years of regular service, as per the instructions issued in this regard.

ITBP CAPF MOSB Medical Officer Selection Process

Candidates whose online applications are found in order will be issued an e-admit card mentioning date, time and venue for Documentation & Interview by a designated Board of Officers, followed by Physical Standard Tests (PST) and Medical Examination Tests (MET), to assess suitability for appointment in CAPFs & AR.

Documentation

All candidates called for interview must bring a clear, legible printout of the e-admit card along with original testimonials and one set of self-attested copies, including: Matriculation/School Leaving Certificate (age proof); certificate in support of qualification; certificate for completion/undergoing internship; registration certificate from MCI/NMC/State Medical Council; SC/ST/OBC/EWS certificates (as applicable, issued by an authority not below Tehsildar/SDO or equivalent); OBC (NCL) declaration; NOC for Government Servants; discharge certificate for Ex-Servicemen; domicile/citizenship proof; West Pakistani Refugee certificate (if applicable); height relaxation certificate (if applicable); and NCC Grade Certificates, where available. Candidates without these original documents may not be permitted to enter the interview centre.

Interview

The designated board conducts the interview of candidates found eligible after documentation. The interview carries 200 marks and tests general knowledge and ability in the candidate's academic field, along with personality, intellectual curiosity, judgment, alertness, social cohesion, integrity of character, initiative and leadership capability. The minimum qualifying standard is 40% of the total marks (i.e., 80 out of 200), and this minimum is the same for all categories of candidates. Candidates not meeting this standard are eliminated from the selection process.

Physical Standard Test (PST)

Candidates who qualify the interview are checked for physical standards by a designated Board of Officers on the same day or the next day. Candidates who do not meet the minimum required physical standards are eliminated at this stage, though they may prefer an appeal the same day to the nominated appellate authority through the Presiding Officer of the PST Board; the appellate authority's decision is final.

Particulars Male Female
Height 157.5 cms 142 cms
Chest 77 cms unexpanded / 82 cms expanded Not applicable
Weight Proportionate to height and age, as per the standard height-weight chart prescribed by the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India, for direct recruitment in CAPFs

Height is relaxable by 2 cms for candidates falling in the categories of Gorkhas, Garhwalis, Kumaonis, Dogras, Marathas, and candidates belonging to the States of Sikkim, Nagaland, Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Tripura, Mizoram, Meghalaya, Assam, Himachal Pradesh, the Kashmir region of UT Jammu & Kashmir, and UT of Ladakh; and relaxable by 3 cms for candidates belonging to Scheduled Tribes. Candidates seeking such relaxation must submit the prescribed certificate whenever sought by the Recruitment Board.

Medical Examination Test (MET)

Candidates who qualify the PST undergo Medical Examination Test by a duly constituted Board of Medical Officers of CAPFs & AR, on the same day or the following day of the PST, as per medical guidelines issued by the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA UO No. A.VI-1/2014-Rectt (SSB) dated 20/05/2015, as amended). Candidates are declared either "FIT" or "UNFIT". Those declared unfit may undergo a "Review Medical Examination (RME)" by giving written consent within 24 hours of being informed of their unfitness; RME is conducted preferably the next day.

Basic Medical Standards

Near Vision (corrected) Distant Vision (corrected) Refraction Limits Colour Vision
Better eye: N6; Worse eye: N9 Better eye: 6/6 or 6/9; Worse eye: 6/12 or 6/9 Hypermetropia up to +3.50DS; Myopia up to -4.5DS (including Astigmatism +/-1.50). Age-related presbyopic relaxation for near vision: +1DS up to 40 years, +2DS up to 50 years, +3DS for 51–60 years and above (in addition to the distant-vision relaxation). CP-III on Ishihara plates; candidates with colour perception below CP-III are not eligible

No Radial Keratotomy (RK) or other refraction surgery is permitted. Lasik surgery correction is permitted subject to prescribed criteria: interval of 6 months since surgery, age 20–35 years, axial length less than 26 mm and more than 21 mm, corneal thickness of 425 microns, pre-Lasik error up to 6D, vision as per medical guidelines, and normal retinal status.

Candidates must not have knock-knees, flat foot or squint, and must be in good mental and bodily health, free from any medical condition or physical defect likely to interfere with efficient performance of duties.

Tattoo clause: Tattoos depicting religious symbols/figures and the name (as followed in the Indian Army) are permitted. Tattoos are allowed only on the inner aspect of the forearm - left forearm only, being the non-saluting limb - or on the dorsum of the hands, and the size must be less than one-fourth of the particular body part (elbow or hand). Where a tattoo has been removed and has substantially faded, it will be treated as a "scar" and not a tattoo, subject to review by the Medical Board during detailed medical examination.

Merit List

The Medical Officers Selection Board will prepare a merit list based on the aggregate marks awarded to each candidate during the interview. Separate merit lists are also compiled for SC/ST, OBC (NCL) and EWS candidates.

How to Apply for ITBP CAPF MOSB Medical Officer Recruitment 2026

Eligible and interested candidates have to apply online through the ITBP Recruitment website: www.recruitment.itbpolice.nic.in. No other mode of application submission is allowed.

CAPF MOSB Medical Officer Apply Online – Steps

  1. Visit the official ITBP Recruitment website: www.recruitment.itbpolice.nic.in
  2. Refer to the FAQs and "How to Register" links on the website before starting.
  3. Fill your profile and apply online strictly as per the eligibility criteria and instructions given, to avoid disqualification at a later stage.
  4. Upload a clear and legible photo, scanned signature, certificate in support of MBBS or equivalent qualification, certificate for specialized qualification issued by the recognized university, and registration certificate of MCI/NMC/State Medical Council.
  5. Provide a genuine and functional e-mail ID and mobile number, since admit card and all further communication will be sent to these details.
  6. Pay the applicable application fee (if not exempted) through the online payment gateway before the closing date.
  7. Regularly check your registered e-mail (including the spam/junk folder) and the ITBP Recruitment website for updates on admit card and further notices.

Note: ITBP will not be responsible for failure to receive the admit card online, or for power failure, electronic or internet-related problems faced by candidates while applying online. Candidates should come prepared for more than one day's stay under their own arrangements at the recruitment centre, as ITBP reserves the right to issue online admit cards at short notice.

Important Instructions

  • Candidates already in Government service must submit their application through proper channel, along with a duly signed "No Objection Certificate" (Annexure-III) from their employer, agreeing to release them if finally selected; this original certificate must be submitted at the time of document verification, else their candidature will be rejected.
  • Candidates for Specialist Medical Officers (Deputy Commandant) and Medical Officer (Assistant Commandant) must indicate their choice of preference for all CAPFs (BSF, CRPF, ITBP, SSB) & Assam Rifles, in order of preference; this choice, once submitted, is final and no request for change will be entertained. The post of Super Specialist Medical Officer (Second-in-Command) is available in ITBP only.
  • Candidates shall be required to serve the Force for a minimum period of 10 years. Resignation before completion of 10 years requires refund of a sum equal to three months' pay and allowances, or the cost of training imparted, whichever is higher.
  • Every candidate appointed shall be on probation for two years, extendable by one year at the discretion of the Central Government. Services may be terminated during or at the end of the probation period without assigning any reason.
  • No candidate appointed to these posts shall be permitted private practice, including consultancy and laboratory practice. No extension in service will be granted beyond the age of superannuation.
  • Disqualification: No person who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living, or who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any other person, shall be eligible for appointment - unless the Central Government is satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal law applicable and exempts the person from this rule.
  • Candidates called for interview from outstation will be paid travelling expenses as per Ministry of Finance OM No. F-19045/1/74/E-IV(B) dated 30-01-1976. No TA is admissible for a journey up to 250 km; for journeys exceeding 250 km, the candidate bears the cost of the initial 250 km on each of the outward and return journeys, and the remaining distance is reimbursed as a single second-class rail fare or actual bus fare. For SC/ST candidates, the fare for the first 30 km of both outward and return journeys is borne by the candidate. This concession is not admissible to candidates already employed in Central/State Government, Corporations, Public Undertakings, Local Government institutions or Panchayats.
  • Mere presence and qualifying in the medical examination does not guarantee a right to appointment. The Selection Committee, on behalf of the Government of India, reserves the right to reject or accept the candidature of any applicant at any stage.
  • The Selection Committee will not enter into any correspondence with candidates except in case of a change of address sought by the candidate.
  • Information in this advertisement and on the website are guidelines only; in case of any ambiguity, the existing rules and regulations of the Government of India will be final. Any further information/notice regarding this recruitment will be uploaded only on the ITBP Recruitment website.

Human Space Flight Centre (HSFC) Scientist/Engineer SD Recruitment 2026 Notification has been released on 10th August 2026 on the official website www.hsfc.gov.in. A total of 6 vacancies have been announced through the HSFC Scientist/Engineer SD Recruitment 2026 for various disciplines including Bioinstrumentation, Biophysics, Medical Physics, Biotechnology, Cellular & Molecular Biology, Computational Biology, Bioinformatics and Biomedical Engineering.

Candidates up to 35 years of age who have the required Ph.D. along with the prescribed Master's/Bachelor's qualification are eligible to apply for these Scientist/Engineer SD vacancies. The online application process for HSFC Scientist/Engineer SD Recruitment 2026 will start on 10th August 2026 and will remain open until 30th August 2026 at 5:00 PM.

Selected candidates will be appointed in Level-11 of the Pay Matrix with a salary of Rs. 67,700 – Rs. 2,08,700 per month, along with admissible allowances and other benefits. Candidates can download the official notification PDF and apply online through the direct links provided below in this article.

HSFC Scientist/Engineer SD Recruitment 2026 Overview

Human Space Flight Centre (HSFC), Bengaluru was formed within ISRO to lead the Human Space Flight Programme. HSFC is inviting online applications for direct recruitment to Scientist/Engineer 'SD' posts in Level-11 of the Pay Matrix, vide Advertisement No. HSFC:01:RMT:2026 dated 10.08.2026.

Particulars Details
Advertisement No. HSFC:01:RMT:2026, dated 10.08.2026
Organization Human Space Flight Centre (HSFC), Department of Space, ISRO
Post Scientist/Engineer 'SD' (Group 'A')
Pay Level Level-11 of Pay Matrix
Total Posts 6 (Post Codes 01 to 06)
Nature of Post Temporary, but likely to continue
Application Mode Online via ISRO Live Register portal
Official Website www.hsfc.gov.in / careers.hsfc.gov.in

HSFC Scientist/Engineer SD Important Dates

Event Date
Opening date for online registration and application 10.08.2026 (1000 hrs)
Closing date for online registration, application submission and printing of summary 30.08.2026 (1700 hrs)
Crucial date of eligibility (for qualification, age, etc.) 30.08.2026

Candidates who register on ISRO's Live Register portal before 10.08.2026 or after 30.08.2026 will not be considered.

HSFC Scientist/Engineer SD Vacancy Details

All 6 posts are in the Unreserved (UR) category. The number of vacancies is provisional and may be increased or decreased based on actual requirement.

Total 6

Candidates can apply for more than one post code if they meet the eligibility for each, though HSFC reserves the right to conduct interviews for two or more posts simultaneously as per administrative need. Where discipline names overlap (as in Post Codes 05 and 06), candidates should apply only against the post code matching their essential and pre-requisite qualification.

HSFC Scientist/Engineer SD Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility is assessed as on the crucial date of 30.08.2026. Only candidates who hold the required qualification by this date can apply.

HSFC Scientist/Engineer SD Qualification (Post-Code Wise)

Post Code Discipline Essential Qualification Pre-requisite Qualification
01 Bioinstrumentation / Biophysics / Medical Physics Ph.D. in Bioinstrumentation, Biophysics or Medical Physics ME/M.Tech/MS in Biomedical-Instrumentation, Medical Imaging & Informatics, Healthcare Informatics, Biomedical Engineering or Bioengineering (60% marks / 6.5 CGPA) AND BE/B.Tech in any field (65% marks / 6.84 CGPA)
02 Developmental Biology / Biotechnology Ph.D. in Developmental Biology or Biotechnology ME/M.Tech/MS in Biotechnology, Bioscience & Bioengineering, Biochemical Engineering or Biological Sciences (60% / 6.5 CGPA) AND BE/B.Tech in any field (65% / 6.84 CGPA); OR BS-MS dual degree in Biological Sciences (60% / 6.5 CGPA)
03 Cellular & Molecular Biology / Cell Biology Ph.D. in Cellular & Molecular Biology or Cell Biology MSc in Microbiology, Molecular Biology, Cell and Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Genetics or Life Sciences (60% / 6.5 CGPA) AND BSc in any field (60% / 6.5 CGPA); OR BS-MS dual degree in Biological Sciences (60% / 6.5 CGPA)
04 Computational Biology / Systems Biology / Bioinformatics Ph.D. in Computational Biology, Systems Biology or Bioinformatics ME/M.Tech/MS in Biomedical Engineering, Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Biotechnology, Bioscience & Bioengineering or Biochemical Engineering (60% / 6.5 CGPA) AND BE/B.Tech in any field (65% / 6.84 CGPA); OR BS-MS dual degree in Biological Sciences (60% / 6.5 CGPA)
05 Biomedical Engineering / Biomedical Sciences Ph.D. in Biomedical Engineering or Biomedical Sciences with thesis in biomechanics, human movement, musculoskeletal modeling or equivalent ME/M.Tech/MS in Biomechanics, Biomechanical Engineering or Biomedical Engineering (60% / 6.5 CGPA) AND BE/B.Tech in any field (65% / 6.84 CGPA)
06 Biomedical Engineering / Biomedical Sciences Ph.D. in Biomedical Engineering or Biomedical Sciences with thesis in bio-imaging, signal processing, bioinformatics or equivalent ME/M.Tech/MS in Biomedical Engineering, Bioinformatics, Biotechnology, Bioscience & Bioengineering, Medical Imaging & Informatics or Biomedical Signal Processing (60% / 6.5 CGPA) AND BE/B.Tech in any field (65% / 6.84 CGPA)

Additional qualification conditions:

  • The Ph.D. and Master's/Bachelor's qualification must be from a recognized university/institute.
  • Candidates with degrees from foreign universities must submit an equivalency certificate from the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) at the time of interview.
  • The ME/M.Tech/MS/MSc/BE/B.Tech/BSc/BS-MS qualification must have been completed within the stipulated duration prescribed by the university.
  • Candidates who completed a professional course through Open and Distance Learning (ODL) are not eligible.
  • Where CGPA is converted to a percentage, or vice versa, ISRO's own eligibility criteria apply; conversion of CGPA to percentage using a university formula is not permitted to determine eligibility, and rounding-off of marks is not allowed.

HSFC Scientist/Engineer SD Age Limit

The upper age limit for all post codes (01 to 06) is 35 years as on the crucial date, 30.08.2026. Serving Central Government employees, Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), and Ex-Servicemen are eligible for age relaxation as per extant Government of India rules.

Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

HSFC Scientist/Engineer SD Salary

Selected candidates will be placed in Level-11 of the Pay Matrix (Rs. 67,700 – Rs. 2,08,700), with approximate gross emoluments of Rs. 67,700 per month plus admissible allowances.

Post Pay Level Approx. Gross Emoluments
Scientist/Engineer SD (Post Code 01–06) Level-11 (Rs. 67,700 – Rs. 2,08,700) Rs. 67,700 per month + admissible allowances

In addition to Basic Pay, Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA) and Transport Allowance are payable as per extant rules. Employees are covered under the National Pension System/Unified Pension Scheme, along with medical facilities for self and dependents, subsidized canteen, quarters facility (in lieu of HRA), Leave Travel Concession, Group Insurance and House Building Advance, as admissible under DOS/Central Government orders.

HSFC Scientist/Engineer SD Application Fee

There is no application fee for the Scientist/Engineer 'SD' posts (Post Codes 01–06).

HSFC Scientist/Engineer SD Selection Process

Selection is based on the online application submitted through the ISRO Live Register portal:

  • Initial screening of applications to shortlist candidates for interview.
  • The prescribed qualification is the minimum requirement and does not by itself make a candidate eligible for interview or selection.
  • Final selection is based purely on performance in the Personal Interview.

Candidates also have the option to give the interview in Hindi.

How to Apply for HSFC Scientist/Engineer SD Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the ISRO Live Register portal at www.isro.gov.in and go to the "Career" tab.
  2. Register or update your existing registration on the Live Register portal.
  3. Fill in the online application form carefully, entering correct details in all mandatory (*) fields.
  4. Apply only against the post code matching your essential and pre-requisite qualification.
  5. Upload the required photo, signature and qualification certificates as specified.
  6. Submit the application on or before 30.08.2026 (1700 hrs) and take a printout of the submitted application for future reference.

Candidates registered under the National Career Service (NCS) portal and meeting the eligibility conditions may also visit the ISRO website and follow the same application procedure.

HSFC Scientist/Engineer SD Apply Online

Applications are accepted only online through the ISRO Live Register portal; physical/postal applications are not entertained. No documents need to be sent by post or email.

KRCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27 Eligibility Criteria

KRCL Apprentice Qualification

Candidates must have passed out during 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, or 2025 (within the last 5 years from the date of passing the qualifying exam and date of joining training). Qualification requirements by category:

  • Category I – Graduate Apprentices (Engineering): BE/B.Tech in Civil Engineering; or Electrical/Electronics & Power Engineering (or a combination of basic Electrical sub-streams) for Electrical Engineering; or Electrical/Electronics/Information Technology/Communication Engineering/Computer Science & Engineering/Computer Science/Computer Engineering (or a combination of these basic streams) for Electronics Engineering; or Mechanical/Industrial/Automobile/Production Engineering for Mechanical Engineering - from an AICTE-recognized university.
  • Category II – Technician (Diploma) Apprentices: Diploma in Civil Engineering; or Electrical/Electronics & Power Engineering (or a combination of basic streams) for Electrical; or Electrical/Electronics/Information Technology/Communication Engineering/Computer Science & Engineering/Computer Science/Computer Engineering (or a combination) for Electronics; or Mechanical/Industrial/Automobile/Production Engineering for Mechanical - from a University or Institution recognized by the Central/State Govt. KRCL Apprentice Physical Fitness

Candidates must meet the minimum physical fitness standards prescribed in the notification and must bring a medical certificate, in the prescribed Apprentice Act, 1961 format, certified by a Government Doctor not below the rank of Assistant Surgeon of the Central/State Medical Services, at the time of Document Verification. Final medical fitness is certified by KRCL's Medical Authority, and the cost of the medical examination is borne by the candidate.

KRCL Apprentice Trainee Stipend

Stipend is paid through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mechanism, combining the Government of India's DBT share and KRCL's establishment share.

Category Government DBT Share (per month) KRCL Establishment Share (per month)

Technician (Diploma) Apprentices Rs. 5,450 Rs. 5,450

Candidates must have a bank account in their own name and a PAN card to receive the stipend, and must retain the same Aadhaar-linked bank account until training completion. Candidates must also make their own lodging and boarding arrangements during training.

KRCL Apprentice Trainee Application/ Processing Fee

The exact processing/examination fee amount is not specified in the provided notification. The notification does describe fee-waiver provisions: candidates from Economically Weaker Sections can submit an income certificate issued by the Tehsildar to seek a fee waiver, and Minority community candidates can submit a self-declaration affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper to claim a fee waiver, in the prescribed formats.

KRCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27 Selection Process

  • For all categories, marks obtained across all years/semesters are summed to arrive at an aggregate percentage, and a merit list is prepared accordingly. No rounding off is done, and no weightage is given to any particular semester or year.
  • In case of a tie in marks, the older candidate is preferred; if dates of birth are also the same, the candidate who passed matriculation earlier is selected.
  • Land loser candidates (as defined in the notification, whose land was acquired for the Konkan Railway Project) are given first preference in selection.
  • Candidates from the districts under KRCL's jurisdiction - Raigad, Ratnagiri and Sindhudurg (Maharashtra), North Goa and South Goa (Goa), and Uttara Kannada, Udupi and Dakshina Kannada (Karnataka) - are given second preference.

  • Semester/year-wise mark sheets along with Degree/Diploma certificate

  • Income certificate from the Tehsildar and Minority Community declaration affidavit, for fee waiver where applicable

  • Aadhaar card and PAN card
  • A valid, approved NATS ID

How to Apply for KRCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27

The notification does not describe a separate online application form with a fee-payment step; engagement is through NATS portal registration followed by walk-in Document Verification. To participate in KRCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27:

  1. Register on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal and obtain a valid, approved NATS ID.
  2. Check your post-wise Document Verification date from the schedule (24, 25, 27 or 28 August 2026).
  3. Prepare original documents along with self-attested photocopies, as listed in the Required Documents section.
  4. Arrive at the venue - Executives Club, Konkan Rail Vihar, Sector-40, Opp. Seawoods Railway Station (West), Navi Mumbai-400706 - and complete registration between 9:00 AM and 12:00 PM on your scheduled date.
  5. Attend Document Verification, along with the prescribed medical certificate.

Selection is cancelled if a candidate fails to produce the required original testimonials at Document Verification, or if any discrepancy is noticed at any stage.

KRCL Apprentice Trainee Important Instructions

  • Candidates should enter their name, father's name, and date of birth exactly as recorded in their Matriculation/SSC/High School certificate.
  • Candidates must maintain an active personal email ID for the entire duration of enrolment, as KRCL will send all communications only through email; requests to change the registered mobile number or email will not be entertained.
  • Furnishing wrong, fake, or false certificates can lead to termination of the training contract.
  • Training in KRCL does not confer any right to future employment or absorption in KRCL after completion.
  • The duration of training is 1 year, and candidates can be deployed anywhere within KRCL's jurisdiction.
  • Canvassing or pressuring through any source will disqualify the candidature without prior intimation.
  • The decision of the KRCL administration on eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, and mode of selection is final.

RCF Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Notification Out

Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited (RCF Ltd), a Navratna Government of India undertaking, has released the RCF Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Notification (Advertisement No. 16022026) for the recruitment of 94 Management Trainee posts across 14 disciplines. Eligible candidates can apply online for disciplines including Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Civil, Fire, Information Technology, Finance, Marketing, Rajbhasha and other streams.

The RCF Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 online application process will start on 08 August 2026 and continue till 24 August 2026. Candidates selected through the Online Test and Personal Interview process will undergo one-year traineeship and may be absorbed in the E1 grade after successful completion.

RCF Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Overview

RCF is inviting applications from eligible engineering graduates, postgraduates and professionally qualified candidates for one-year traineeship positions leading to absorption in the E1 grade. Candidates can apply online only through the official RCF website. Here is a quick summary of the RCF Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 before the detailed sections below.

RCF Management Trainee Vacancy 2026 Details

RCF Management Trainee Vacancy 2026 covers 94 posts across 14 disciplines. The table below gives the post code, discipline, total vacancies, and category-wise reservation breakup (UR, SC, ST, OBC-NCL, EWS, PwBD).

RCF Management Trainee Eligibility Criteria

RCF Management Trainee Eligibility depends on the discipline applied for. Only Indian citizens meeting both the educational qualification and age limit as on 01.02.2026 can apply. Below is a discipline-wise summary; the official notification carries the complete list of accepted degree combinations (regular 4-year degree, 3-year degree after diploma, or dual/integrated degree) for each post.

RCF Management Trainee Qualification (Discipline-wise)

Discipline Core Qualification Requirement Minimum Percentage
Chemical Regular full-time BE/B.Tech in Chemical Engineering / Chemical Technology / Petrochemical Engineering / Petrochemical Technology (or equivalent 3-year degree after diploma, or dual/integrated degree) from a UGC/AICTE-recognised institution 60% (55% for SC/ST)
Boiler BE/B.Tech in Chemical / Petrochemical / Mechanical / Instrumentation / Electrical, plus a valid Boiler Operation Engineer's Certificate (BOE) or Boiler Proficiency Certificate from a Statutory Authority 60% (55% for SC/ST)
Mechanical BE/B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering (or 3-year degree after diploma, or dual/integrated degree) from UGC/AICTE-approved institutions 60%
Electrical BE/B.Tech in Electrical Engineering / Electrical and Power Engineering / Electrical Power Engineering 60% (55% for SC/ST)
Instrumentation BE/B.Tech in Instrumentation Engineering / Instrumentation Technology / Instrumentation and Control Engineering 60% (55% for SC/ST)
Materials BE/B.Tech in Chemical, Petrochemical, Chemical Technology, Mechanical, Electrical, Electrical and Power, Instrumentation, Instrumentation Technology, or Instrumentation and Control Engineering (this post is reserved for ST/PwBD-Low Vision category as per the notification) 55% for ST category
Civil BE/B.Tech in Civil Engineering or allied disciplines (Civil and Infrastructure Engineering, Construction Engineering, Construction Technology and Management, etc.) 60%
Fire BE/B.Tech in Fire or Fire & Safety discipline from UGC/AICTE-approved institutions 60%
CC Lab Ph.D. in Chemistry (preferred) OR BE/B.Tech in Chemical Engineering / Petrochemical Engineering / Chemical Technology No percentage criteria for Ph.D.; 60% for engineering graduates

Finance CA/CMA, OR a full-time graduation degree in Commerce/Accounting/Finance (B.Com, BMS, BAF, BBA) plus a 2-year full-time MBA/MMS/PGDM with specialisation in Finance. M.Com alone is not considered. No percentage criteria for CA/CMA; 60% for the postgraduate route (55% for SC/ST)

Candidates in the final year of graduation or post-graduation are not eligible to apply.

RCF Management Trainee Age Limit

The upper age limit is calculated as on 01.02.2026 and varies by category. The general pattern followed across most disciplines is given below; a few posts (such as Boiler, Materials, CC Lab, Rajbhasha, Civil, and Fire) have narrower category-specific age limits because reservation is not notified for every category in those posts. Candidates should refer to the specific post-code table in the official notification for the exact age limit applicable to their category and discipline.

PwBD (SC/ST) Up to 42 years, where notified for the post
PwBD (OBC-NCL) Up to 40 years, where notified for the post

An additional age relaxation of 5 years is available to children/family members of victims of the 1984 riots, across all categories. Age relaxation for SC/ST and OBC(NCL) candidates applying against reserved posts is up to 5 years and 3 years respectively; PwBD candidates get further relaxation as specified in the notification.

RCF Management Trainee Salary

Selected candidates undergo a one-year training period and are paid a lump sum stipend of ₹60,000 per month during this period. Free hostel accommodation on a sharing basis is provided at Trombay/Thal, along with medical facility at the RCF Hospital.

On successful completion of training, trainees are absorbed in the E1 Grade with a pay scale of ₹40,000–₹140,000. The minimum total monthly gross emoluments (Basic Pay + VDA at 51.80% + Perks at 34% + HRA at 30% and other allowances) work out to approximately ₹86,320. Management Trainees posted outside Trombay and Thal (such as at Marketing Area Offices) additionally receive a fixed allowance of ₹5,000 per month towards boarding, lodging, and local travel, plus TA/DA on tours.

A bond amount of ₹2 lakh must be deposited by the Management Trainee at the time of joining as a fixed deposit with lien marked to RCF Ltd, for a period of 4 years including the one-year training period. On absorption, employees also become eligible for company accommodation (subject to availability), Performance Related Pay, free medical facility for self and dependents, gratuity, contributory provident fund, accident insurance, and pension scheme as per company rules.

RCF Management Trainee Application Fee

Category Application Fee
General / OBC (NCL) / EWS ₹1,000 plus applicable bank charges and GST
SC / ST / Ex-Servicemen / PwBD / Female candidates Exempted - no application fee

Fees can be paid online only, through internet banking, debit card, or credit card. Once paid, the application fee is non-refundable under any circumstances, so candidates are advised to verify their eligibility before making the payment.

RCF Management Trainee Selection Process

The RCF Management Trainee Selection Process consists of an Online Test followed by a Personal Interview.

Online Test

  • Computer-based objective test of 90 minutes, with 100 questions in total.
  • 50 questions (2 marks each) are from the course curriculum of the relevant discipline/qualifying degree.
  • 50 questions (1 mark each) cover General English, Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning, and General Knowledge/Awareness.
  • There is negative marking for wrong answers.
  • The test is conducted in Hindi (Rajbhasha) and English, at centres in Bhopal, Delhi/Delhi NCR, Lucknow, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Guwahati, Kolkata, Mumbai/Navi Mumbai/Thane/MMR region, and Nagpur.

Personal Interview

  • Based on online test performance and document verification, eligible candidates are provisionally called for interview in a ratio of approximately 1:7 (7 candidates per post).
  • Candidates must score a minimum average of 50% in the interview to qualify.
  • Outstation candidates are reimbursed III-tier AC train/bus fare for both the online test and interview, as per the terms in the notification.

Final Merit List

Parameter Weightage
Online Test 80%
Personal Interview 20%

Separate category-wise and discipline-wise merit lists are prepared. Candidates with nil or negative marks in the online test are not eligible for interview. Final selection is also subject to a pre-employment medical examination and document verification.

RCF Management Trainee Required Documents

  • Recent passport-size colour photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm) as per specified scan requirements
  • Signature scanned on white paper with black ink
  • Left thumb impression on white paper with black or blue ink
  • Handwritten declaration (in the candidate's own handwriting, in English) as per the format given in the notification
  • Valid photo identity proof (PAN Card, Passport, Driving Licence, Voter's Card, Aadhaar, etc. - Ration Card and Learner's Licence are not accepted)
  • Caste certificate in the prescribed proforma, where applicable (SC/ST/OBC-NCL)
  • Income and Asset Certificate for EWS candidates, issued on or after 1 April 2025
  • Disability certificate for PwBD candidates, as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2017
  • No Objection Certificate (NOC), for candidates currently employed in Government/PSU/Autonomous Bodies
  • Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets relevant to the applied discipline

How to Apply for RCF Management Trainee Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official RCF website, www.rcfltd.com, and click on "Apply Online".
  2. Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter your name, contact details, and email ID to generate a Provisional Registration Number and Password.
  3. Fill in the application form, using "Save and Next" to complete it in stages if required.
  4. Upload the scanned photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and handwritten declaration as per the specifications in the notification.
  5. Upload other required documents (single combined PDF file per category, maximum 500 KB) as listed in the advertisement.
  6. Preview and validate all details before clicking "Complete Registration".
  7. Pay the application fee online, where applicable, and take a printout of the e-receipt.
  8. Click "Submit" to complete the RCF Management Trainee Apply Online process.

RCF Management Trainee Apply Online: Important Instructions

  • Only online applications are accepted; physical application forms will not be considered.
  • Details submitted in the online application form, including correspondence address, email address, mobile number, category, post applied for, and test city, cannot be changed after submission.
  • Candidates must possess a valid personal email ID and mobile number, kept active throughout the recruitment process, as all communication will be sent electronically.
  • Candidates already employed in Central/State Government, Quasi-Government, PSUs, or Autonomous Bodies must apply through proper channel or submit a No Objection Certificate at the time of interview.
  • RCF reserves the right to cancel, restrict, enlarge, or modify the recruitment process, and to increase or decrease the number of vacancies, without prior notice.
  • Any corrigendum or update will be published only on www.rcfltd.com under "HR → Recruitment"; no separate press advertisement will be issued.

IOB Local Bank Officer Selection Process 2026-27

There is a penalty of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer, with no penalty for unattempted questions. There is no sectional cut-off, but the minimum qualifying aggregate is 30% for reserved category candidates and 35% for unreserved candidates.

Language Proficiency Test (LPT)

Personal Interview

The Personal Interview carries 100 marks. The minimum qualifying marks are 45% for reserved category candidates and 50% for unreserved candidates.

Final Selection

The weightage of Online Examination and Personal Interview is in the ratio of 80:20. The minimum aggregate score (Online Exam + Interview) required is 30% for reserved categories and 35% for unreserved category candidates. The final merit list is prepared state-wise and category-wise.

Probation and Bond

Selected candidates will be on probation for 2 years of active service from the date of joining. They must execute a Financial Service Indemnity Bond of ₹2,00,000 for rendering a minimum of 3 years of service.

State Bank of India (SBI) has released Advertisement No. CRPD/CR/SPLDRIVE/2026-27/16 for recruitment of Junior Associate (Customer Support & Sales) in the clerical cadre, popularly searched as SBI Clerk Recruitment 2026. This is a Special Recruitment Drive for SC/ST/OBC backlog vacancies only - it is not open to General/Unreserved or EWS candidates. A total of 1538 vacancies (SC: 207, ST: 1219, OBC: 112) are available across 21 states/UTs. Graduates aged 20 to 28 years (as on 01.04.2026) belonging to SC, ST, or OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) categories can apply online between 07.08.2026 and 27.08.2026. Selection involves an online Preliminary Examination, Main Examination, and a Local Language Proficiency Test where applicable. The Preliminary Exam is tentatively scheduled for September 2026, and the Main Exam for October/November 2026.

SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026 Eligibility

Who Can Apply

This drive is open only to candidates belonging to the SC, ST, and OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) categories against backlog vacancies. General/UR and EWS category candidates are not eligible to apply under this specific advertisement.

Educational Qualification (As on 31.12.2026)

  • Graduation in any discipline from a recognised university, or an equivalent qualification recognised by the Central Government.
  • Candidates with an Integrated Dual Degree (IDD) certificate must ensure the date of passing the IDD is on or before 31.12.2026.
  • Candidates in their final year/semester of graduation may apply provisionally, subject to producing proof of having passed by 31.12.2026, if provisionally selected.
  • Matriculate Ex-servicemen who have obtained the Indian Army Special Certificate of Education (or equivalent Navy/Air Force certificate), after completing at least 15 years of service, are also eligible.

Who Is NOT Eligible

  • Candidates currently working in SBI's Clerical cadre.
  • Candidates previously employed in SBI who resigned while in the clerical cadre.
  • Candidates against whom there is an adverse report regarding character, antecedents, or moral turpitude.
  • OBC candidates falling under the "Creamy Layer."

PwBD (Persons with Benchmark Disabilities)

The post is identified as suitable for candidates with Blindness/Low Vision, Deafness/Hard of Hearing, specified locomotor disabilities (One/Both Arms or Legs, Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victims, Muscular Dystrophy, Spinal Deformity/Injury without associated neurological dysfunction), Autism Spectrum Disorder (Mild), Intellectual Disability, Specific Learning Disability, Mental Illness, and Multiple Disabilities involving the above. PwBD candidates apply under their respective parent category (SC/ST/OBC) as there is no horizontal PwBD reservation in this drive; a valid Disability Certificate on the prescribed format, dated on or before the last date of registration, is required to avail concessions such as scribe facility and compensatory time.

Ex-Servicemen (XS)

Candidates must meet the definition of Ex-Serviceman as per Government of India, Ministry of Home Affairs Notification No. 36034/5/85/Estt(SCT) dated 27th October 1986 (as amended). Disabled Ex-Servicemen, dependents of servicemen killed in action, and Territorial Army Personnel (w.e.f. 15.11.1986) are covered under specific conditions detailed in the official notification, including submission of the applicable Proforma (A, B, C, or D) as relevant to their service status.

How to Apply for SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026

📄 Complete Details & Notification

The State Bank of India (SBI) has released the notification for recruitment of Junior Associates (Customer Support & Sales) under a Special Recruitment Drive for SC/ST/OBC Backlog Vacancies (Advertisement No. CRPD/CR/SPLDRIVE/2026-27/16). Online registration is open from 7 August 2026 to 27 August 2026. This article explains the exam pattern for Prelims and Mains, the Local Language Proficiency Test, marking scheme, and selection process exactly as given in the official notification.

Note on syllabus: The official notification specifies the names of the test sections, number of questions, marks, and duration for each phase, but it does not publish a topic-wise syllabus. Wherever this article lists sub-topics for a section, it is clearly marked as a general guide and not an officially notified syllabus. If a detail is not available in the notification, this article states that explicitly instead of assuming it.

SBI Junior Associate Exam Pattern 2026

The selection process has three stages: Preliminary Examination, Main Examination, and (where applicable) a Local Language Proficiency Test. Both online tests carry negative marking of 1/4th mark for every wrong answer.

Phase I: Preliminary Examination Pattern

The Prelims is an objective test of 100 marks and 1 hour total duration, split into three separately timed sections. There is no sectional cut-off, but the Bank shortlists candidates for Mains based on aggregate marks (approximately 10 times the number of vacancies per category, subject to availability).

S.No. Test Name Medium of Exam No. of Questions Max. Marks Duration
1 English Language English 30 30 20 minutes
2 Numerical Ability English/Hindi (as per state) 35 35 20 minutes
3 Reasoning Ability English/Hindi (as per state) 35 35 20 minutes
Total 100 100 1 Hour

Phase II: Main Examination Pattern

The Main Exam is an objective test of 200 marks over 2 hours 40 minutes, with four separately timed sections. Only the aggregate marks obtained in the Main Examination are used to prepare the final merit list Prelims marks are not added at this stage.

S.No. Test Name Medium of Exam No. of Questions Max. Marks Duration
1 General/Financial Awareness English/Hindi (as per state) 50 50 35 minutes
2 General English English 40 40 35 minutes
3 Quantitative Aptitude English/Hindi (as per state) 50 50 45 minutes
4 Reasoning Ability & Computer Aptitude English/Hindi (as per state) 50 60 45 minutes
Total 190 200 2 Hr. 40 min.

Candidates must score minimum qualifying marks on aggregate, as decided by the Bank; there are no individual sectional qualifying marks, and sectional marks are not maintained separately.

Phase III: Local Language Proficiency Test (LLPT)

Provisionally selected candidates who have not studied the specified local language of the applied state in Class 10 or 12 must appear for the LLPT after Main Exam qualification but before joining. Candidates who submit a 10th/12th mark sheet showing the local language as a subject are exempted from this test.

S.No. Test Pattern Section No. of Passages No. of Questions Max. Marks
1 Non-Verbal Test Objective 3 15 15
1 Non-Verbal Test Subjective 3 15 15
2 Verbal Test - - 20

Candidates who fail to qualify the LLPT will not be offered appointment.

SBI Junior Associate Syllabus 2026 (Section-wise Guide)

The notification does not release a detailed, topic-wise syllabus it only names the test sections shown above. Based on the officially named sections, the following are the broad areas typically covered under each section for this kind of clerical-cadre banking exam. Treat this as a general study guide, not an official syllabus document.

Prelims Sections

  • English Language: Reading comprehension, cloze test, para jumbles, error detection, fill in the blanks, vocabulary-based questions.
  • Numerical Ability: Simplification, number series, quadratic equations, data interpretation, arithmetic problems (percentage, profit & loss, average, ratio, time & work, simple/compound interest).
  • Reasoning Ability: Puzzles, seating arrangement, syllogism, inequality, coding-decoding, blood relations, direction sense, alphanumeric series.

Mains Sections

  • General/Financial Awareness: Current affairs, banking and financial awareness, static general knowledge.
  • General English: Comprehension, grammar, vocabulary, sentence correction, and para-based questions at a slightly higher difficulty than Prelims.
  • Quantitative Aptitude: Data interpretation, data sufficiency, arithmetic word problems, number series, simplification/approximation.
  • Reasoning Ability & Computer Aptitude: Advanced puzzles and seating arrangement, logical reasoning, plus basic computer knowledge (fundamentals, MS Office, internet, and banking-related computer terms).

Also Read: Bihar BPSC Auditor OMR Sheet 2026

How to Apply

  • Visit the official SBI careers page: https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings
  • Locate and open the "Special Recruitment drive for Junior Associates 2026" link.
  • Download and carefully read Advertisement No. CRPD/CR/SPLDRIVE/2026-27/16.
  • Register online with a valid email ID and mobile number.
  • Fill in the application form and upload the scanned photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and hand-written declaration.
  • Pay the application fee (if applicable) using debit card, credit card, or internet banking.
  • Submit the form and save/print the system-generated application form for your records (this printout is not to be sent to SBI).

Important Instructions

  • Candidates can apply for vacancies in one State/UT only and can appear for the test only once under this recruitment project.
  • There is no provision for Inter-Circle or Inter-State transfer, except intra-state transfer between Delhi Circle & Lucknow Circle (Uttar Pradesh) and between Mumbai Metro Circle & Maharashtra Circle (Maharashtra), subject to the Bank's extant guidelines.
  • No changes or corrections to submitted application particulars, including category, will be entertained under any circumstances.
  • Mobile phones, smartwatches, calculators, and similar devices are strictly prohibited inside the examination premises.
  • A wait list of up to 50% of vacancies (state-category wise) will be maintained and released quarterly, valid for one year from the date of declaration of the final result.
  • SBI reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process entirely at any stage.
  • SBI has clarified it does not endorse any external coaching platform or consultancy claiming to guarantee selection; candidates should rely only on the official career portal.

Bank of Baroda (BoB) has released a notification, vide Advertisement No. BOB/HRM/REC/ADVT/2026/15, inviting online applications for the recruitment of human resources on a regular basis across various departments. The BoB Recruitment 2026 drive covers 206 vacancies spread over 22 posts in Digital Banking, Facility Management, Information Security, Security, Enterprise Data Management Office, and Corporate Accounts & Taxation Planning departments. Eligible candidates who are graduates or postgraduates in relevant streams such as Engineering, Computer Applications, Commerce, or hold professional qualifications like CA/ICWA can apply online through the Bank's official career page from 06.08.2026 to 26.08.2026. Selected candidates will be posted anywhere in India as per the Bank's requirement, and the recruitment process includes application scrutiny, an online test (if conducted), and psychometric test/interview.

BoB Professionals Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection process for BoB Recruitment 2026 may comprise Application Scrutiny, an Online Test, a Psychometric Test, and/or a Group Discussion and Personal Interview, as decided by the Bank for each post.

  • Online Test (if conducted): Tentative structure includes Reasoning (25 questions/25 marks), English Language (25 questions/25 marks), Quantitative Aptitude (25 questions/25 marks), and Professional Knowledge (75 questions/150 marks), for a total of 150 questions/225 marks in 150 minutes. Reasoning, English Language, and Quantitative Aptitude sections are qualifying in nature; only Professional Knowledge marks count toward the final result. There is a penalty of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer.
  • Psychometric Test/Personal Interview (PI): Conducted to assess personality, communication, problem-solving ability, efficiency, and willingness to work in any part of the country. The minimum qualifying marks for PI are 60% for General & EWS category and 55% for other reserved categories.
  • Final Selection: Based on combined scores from the Online Test and/or PI, subject to vacancies available under the respective category.

BoB Professionals Recruitment 2026 Documents Required

Candidates must produce the following original documents, along with self-attested photocopies, at the time of interview or any subsequent stage of selection:

  • Printout of the valid Interview Call Letter
  • System-generated printout of the online application form
  • Proof of Date of Birth (birth certificate or SSLC/Std. X marksheet)
  • Photo identity proof (PAN Card/Passport/Driving Licence/Voter's Card/Bank Passbook with photo/Aadhaar card, etc.)
  • Individual semester/year-wise mark sheets and final degree/diploma certificate
  • Caste certificate (for SC/ST/OBC candidates, in the prescribed format)
  • OBC non-creamy layer certificate (valid as on the date of interview)
  • Disability certificate in the prescribed format (for PwBD candidates)
  • Service/Discharge Book and pension payment order (for Ex-servicemen candidates)
  • No Objection Certificate from current employer (for candidates serving in Government/Quasi-Government/PSU/Bank)
  • Documents supporting work experience (appointment letter, salary slips, relieving letter, etc.)
  • Any other relevant document in support of eligibility

How to Apply for BoB Professionals Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official Bank of Baroda website at www.bankofbaroda.bank.in and go to the Career section → Current Opportunities.
  2. Register online using a valid personal email ID and mobile number, which must be kept active till completion of the recruitment process.
  3. Fill in the online application form carefully, upload a scanned photograph, signature, and supporting documents such as Date of Birth proof, qualification certificates, experience letters, and category certificates, as per the specifications given in the notification.
  4. Verify all details before submitting, since no changes are permitted after clicking the Submit button.
  5. Pay the applicable application fee online through Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, or UPI.
  6. On successful payment, download and retain a printout of the e-receipt and the completed application form for future reference.

BoB Professionals Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Only candidates willing to serve anywhere in India should apply, as selected candidates will be posted at the Bank's absolute discretion.
  • Selected candidates will be on probation for a period of 12 months.
  • Candidates selected for JMG/S-I posts must execute a service bond to serve for a minimum of 3 years or pay an amount equivalent to three months' gross salary (not exceeding Rs. 2 lakh) if they leave before completing three years.
  • Candidates selected for MMG/S-II, MMG/S-III, and SMG/S-IV posts must execute a similar service bond, with the payable amount not exceeding Rs. 3 lakh.
  • Change of category is not permitted at any stage after registration of the online application.
  • There is no reservation for Ex-servicemen in the Officers' Cadre.
  • The number of vacancies, including reserved vacancies, is provisional and may vary according to the Bank's actual requirement.
  • Not more than one application should be submitted by a candidate; in case of multiple applications, only the latest valid (completed) application will be retained.

Gandevi Bank Clerk Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility is assessed as on 10 August 2026. Candidates must be domiciled in Gujarat State and must produce relevant original documents (with a photocopy) in support of their identity and eligibility, as and when called for. No change in the category, age, educational qualification, or other details provided during online registration will be permitted at any stage after submission of the application.

Educational Qualification

The minimum qualification for recruitment to the Clerical cadre is a Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognised university with at least 55% marks. However:

  • Candidates holding a Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) degree are not eligible.
  • Candidates holding degrees in Engineering are also not eligible, except those holding a degree in Information Technology or Computer Science (BE/B.Tech or equivalent).
  • Candidates who have passed CA Intermediate or CMA Intermediate are also eligible.

All educational qualifications must be from a recognised University/Institution, with the result declared on or before 10 August 2026 (proper documentary proof of the result declaration date must be submitted at the time of interview). The date of passing the qualifying examination will be reckoned as the date of passing appearing on the mark sheet/provisional certificate. Candidates should also have knowledge of Gujarati, English, and Computers.

Note on a second discrepancy in the source notification: The Eligibility section states that the qualifying result must be declared on or before 10.08.2026, while a separate clause in the Interview Documents section (item e) refers to the result being declared on or before 01.08.2026. This inconsistency exists in the official notification and has been reproduced here without alteration; candidates should confirm the correct cut-off date with the Bank.

The notification does not mention any age relaxation for reserved categories (SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Ex-servicemen, etc.); this detail is not specified.

Payment can be made only through online mode – Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, or Cash Cards/Mobile Wallets. Bank transaction charges for online payment must be borne by the candidate. The fee, once paid, will not be refunded under any circumstances, nor held in reserve for any other examination.

Gandevi Bank Clerk Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Selection consists of an Online Written Examination followed by a Personal Interview. A candidate must qualify in both the Online Examination and the Interview to be considered for the subsequent recruitment process.

Online Examination Pattern

S. No. Name of the Test No. of Questions Maximum Marks Duration
1 Reasoning 40 40 40 minutes
2 English Language 40 40 40 minutes
3 Computer Knowledge 40 40 30 minutes
4 General Awareness (with special reference to Banking Industry) 40 40 30 minutes
5 Numerical Ability 40 40 40 minutes
Total 200 200 180 minutes

All test papers will be available only in English. The Bank reserves the right to modify the structure of the examination, which will be intimated through its website. A penalty of 1/4th of the marks assigned to a question is applied for each wrong answer (negative marking). Test-wise and total scores are reported with decimal points up to two digits, and scores may be equated across sessions to adjust for minor differences in difficulty level.

Examination Centres

The examination will tentatively be conducted in online mode at Surat, Vapi, and Vadodara. No request for change of examination centre will be entertained. The Bank reserves the right to cancel any examination centre, add other centres, or allot a candidate to a centre other than the one opted for, at its discretion. Candidates will appear for the examination at their own risk and expense.

Interview

Candidates shortlisted in the online examination will be called for a Personal Interview, to be conducted at Gandevi only. The centre, venue address, date, and time of the interview will be communicated through the interview call letter, downloadable from the Bank's website. Any request for a change in date/centre of the interview will not be entertained, though the Bank reserves the right to change these at its discretion under unforeseen circumstances.

Documents Required at the Time of Examination

  • Valid Call Letter for the respective date and session of the examination
  • Original photo-identity proof for verification
  • Photocopy of the photo-identity proof

Documents Required at the Time of Interview

  • Printout of the valid Interview Call Letter
  • System-generated printout of the online application form registered for the examination
  • Proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate or SSLC/Std. X Certificate with DOB)
  • Photo Identity proof
  • Mark sheets and certificates for Graduation or equivalent qualification
  • No Objection Certificate (NOC), for candidates serving in Government/quasi-Government offices/Public Sector Undertakings (including Nationalised Banks and Financial Institutions)
  • Experience certificates, if any
  • Valid Domicile Certificate

Valid Photo Identity Proofs

PAN Card, Passport, Permanent Driving Licence, Voter's Card, Bank Passbook with photograph, Photo identity proof issued by a Gazetted Officer on official letterhead, Photo identity proof issued by a People's Representative on official letterhead, valid recent Identity Card issued by a recognised College/University, Aadhaar Card/E-Aadhaar Card with a photograph, Employee ID, or Bar Council Identity Card with photograph. Ration Card and Learner's Driving Licence are not valid ID proofs for this recruitment. The candidate's name on the call letter must exactly match the name on the photo identity proof; candidates who have changed their name (e.g., after marriage) must produce a Gazette notification, marriage certificate, or affidavit as proof.

How to Apply for Gandevi Bank Clerk Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only, through the Bank's official website www.gpcb.bank.in. No other mode of application will be accepted.

Before You Begin: Documents to Keep Ready

  • Scanned photograph (200 x 230 pixels preferred, 20–50 KB, recent colour passport-size, light background)
  • Scanned signature in black ink, not in capital letters (140 x 60 pixels preferred, 10–20 KB)
  • Scanned left thumb impression on white paper in black or blue ink (240 x 240 pixels at 200 DPI, i.e. 3 cm x 3 cm; 20–50 KB; JPG/JPEG format)
  • Scanned hand-written declaration in English, not in capital letters, in the candidate's own handwriting (800 x 400 pixels at 200 DPI, i.e. 10 cm x 5 cm; 50–100 KB; JPG/JPEG format). The declaration text is: "I ___________ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."
  • A valid personal email ID and mobile number, to be kept active until the recruitment process is completed

Steps to Apply Online

  1. Visit www.gpcb.bank.in and click on "APPLY ONLINE".
  2. Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter your Name, Contact details, and Email ID. A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated and also sent by email/SMS – note these down.
  3. Use the "SAVE AND NEXT" option to fill the form in stages if needed, and verify all details carefully, as no change will be possible after clicking "Complete Registration".
  4. Upload your photograph and signature as per the specifications above.
  5. Fill in the remaining details of the application form.
  6. Use the Preview tab to check the entire form before final submission.
  7. Click "Complete Registration" only after verifying that the photograph, signature, and all other details are correct.
  8. Click "Payment" and complete the online fee payment.
  9. Click "Submit" to complete your application.
  10. Take a printout of the system-generated online application form and the e-Receipt for the fee payment, for your records.

All particulars submitted in the online application will be treated as final; no change or modification is allowed after submission. Not more than one application should be submitted by any candidate; in case of multiple applications, only the latest valid (completed) application will be retained, and the fee paid for other registrations will be forfeited.

Important Instructions

  • Merely applying, appearing, and being shortlisted in the examination and/or interview does not imply that a candidate will necessarily be offered employment; the Bank is not liable to assign any reason for rejecting a candidate.
  • A candidate's admission to the examination, shortlisting for interview, and subsequent processes are strictly provisional. If it is found at any stage that a candidate does not fulfil the eligibility norms or has furnished incorrect/false information, the candidature will be rejected; if detected after appointment, services are liable to be summarily terminated.
  • Candidates should not carry mobile phones, pagers, calculators, or similar communication/electronic devices into the examination premises; the Bank cannot assure safekeeping of such items, and any infringement will lead to cancellation of candidature and possible debarment from future examinations.
  • Use of unfair means, impersonation, misbehaviour in the exam/interview hall, or disclosure/transmission of test content can lead to disqualification, debarment from future Bank examinations, criminal prosecution, or termination of service if already appointed.
  • Online applications, once registered, cannot be withdrawn, and the application fee once paid will not be refunded or held in reserve for any other examination.
  • Appointment of selected candidates is subject to being declared medically fit and to the Bank's service and conduct rules.
  • No hard copy of the call letter or Information Handout will be sent by post or courier; candidates must download these from the Bank's website using their Registration Number and Password/Date of Birth.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification of the candidate.
  • Any dispute arising out of this advertisement or the recruitment process is subject to the sole jurisdiction of the Courts situated at Gandevi.
  • In case of any dispute arising from interpretation of a version of this advertisement other than English, the English version available on the Bank's website will prevail.
  • All further announcements and details relating to this recruitment process will be published only on the Bank's authorised website, www.gpcb.bank.in.

SBI Specialist Cadre Officer Selection Process 2026

Selection for all 10 posts across the three advertisements is based on Shortlisting and Interview:

  • Shortlisting: Merely meeting the minimum qualification and experience does not entitle a candidate to an interview call. The shortlisting committee decides the parameters, and the Bank's decision on which candidates to call is final.
  • Interview: Carries 100 marks; qualifying marks are decided by the Bank.
  • Merit List: Prepared in descending order of interview scores; candidates tied at the cut-off are ranked by age (older candidates ranked higher).
  • CTC Negotiation (contractual posts only - DVP, DCTO, VP): Conducted with candidates in merit order, one by one. If a selected candidate does not agree to the negotiated CTC, they are treated as a Voluntary Exit, and the next candidate in the merit list is called.
  • Final Selection: Top-most candidates in the merit list (with successful CTC negotiation, for contractual posts) are finally selected.

  • Persons dismissed or removed from Central/State Government service, or from a public sector or cooperative institution, for corruption or misconduct.
  • Persons convicted of an offence involving moral turpitude and not since rehabilitated.

  • Persons who do not respect the Constitution of India, or have acted against India's sovereignty and integrity, state security, public order, or friendly relations with foreign states, or have insulted the national flag, anthem, or emblem.
  • Persons debarred by any competent authority from government or cooperative institution recruitment or examinations for adopting unfair means such as impersonation or cheating.

The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) conducts the RRB JE Exam to select candidates for Junior Engineer (JE), Depot Material Superintendent (DMS), and Chemical & Metallurgical Assistant (CMA) posts across Indian Railways. The RRB JE 2026 recruitment cycle (CEN 04/2026) was announced in August 2026, with the online application window opening on 14 August 2026. Knowing the RRB JE Syllabus 2026 and exam pattern together is essential before starting preparation, as the exam is conducted in two stages (CBT 1 and CBT 2) that test different subjects and difficulty levels. This article covers the subject-wise syllabus, exam pattern, selection process, and preparation tips for RRB JE.

RRB JE Syllabus and Exam Pattern 2026 - Overview

Feature Details
Conducting Body Railway Recruitment Board (RRB)

Posts Junior Engineer (JE), Depot Material Superintendent (DMS), Chemical & Metallurgical Assistant (CMA)

Marking Scheme 1 mark per correct answer

RRB JE Selection Process 2026

Candidates are selected through the following stages, in order:

  1. First Stage CBT (CBT 1): A screening-level test covering Mathematics, General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Awareness, and General Science. Only candidates who clear CBT 1 (based on RRB's normalization and cut-off process) move to CBT 2.
  2. Second Stage CBT (CBT 2): A more technical test covering General Awareness, Physics & Chemistry, Basics of Computer Applications, Basics of Environment & Pollution Control, and Technical Abilities specific to the candidate's engineering discipline. Final merit is based on CBT 2 performance.
  3. Document Verification (DV): Shortlisted candidates, based on CBT 2 merit and category-wise vacancies, are called to verify educational certificates, category certificates, and other documents.
  4. Medical Examination (ME): Candidates who clear DV undergo a medical fitness test as per the medical standards prescribed for the specific post.

Note: CBT 1 is only a qualifying/screening stage and its marks are not typically counted toward final merit, which is based on CBT 2. This is consistent with the pattern description in the reference sources; candidates should confirm the exact merit-weightage rule in the official notification.

CBT 2 consists of 150 objective-type MCQs, to be completed in 120 minutes (2 hours), with the same marking scheme of 1 mark per correct answer and 1/3 mark negative marking per wrong answer. Since Technical Abilities alone accounts for 100 of the 150 marks in CBT 2, it carries the largest share of this stage this is a direct read of the marks distribution above, not a separate weightage claim from any source.

RRB JE Syllabus 2026

The RRB JE Syllabus is divided into the CBT 1 syllabus (screening-level, common to all candidates) and the CBT 2 syllabus (common sections plus a Technical Abilities section specific to the candidate's engineering branch). The detailed topic-wise breakdown is given below.

1. Mathematics (CBT 1)

  • Number systems
  • BODMAS
  • Decimals
  • Fractions
  • LCM and HCF
  • Ratio and Proportion
  • Percentages
  • Mensuration
  • Time and Work
  • Time and Distance

  • Algebra
  • Geometry

  • Calendar & Clock
  • Pipes & Cistern

2. General Intelligence and Reasoning (CBT 1)

  • Analogies
  • Alphabetical and Number Series
  • Coding and Decoding
  • Mathematical operations
  • Relationships
  • Syllogism
  • Jumbling
  • Venn Diagram
  • Data Interpretation and Sufficiency
  • Conclusions and Decision-Making
  • Similarities and Differences
  • Analytical reasoning
  • Classification
  • Directions
  • Statement – Arguments and Assumptions

3. General Awareness (CBT 1 and CBT 2 – common)

  • Current affairs
  • Indian Geography
  • Culture and history of India, including the freedom struggle
  • Indian Polity and Constitution
  • Indian Economy
  • Environmental issues concerning India and the world, sports, and general scientific and technological developments

4. General Science (CBT 1)

  • Physics, Chemistry, and Life Sciences up to 10th standard CBSE syllabus

5. Physics and Chemistry (CBT 2)

Questions are set from 12th-standard-level Physics and Chemistry, carrying 15 questions in CBT 2.

6. Basics of Computer Applications (CBT 2)

  • Computers and their architecture
  • Input & Output devices
  • MS Office
  • Storage devices
  • Operating Systems
  • Internet and Email
  • Websites & Web Browsers
  • Networking
  • Computer Virus

7. Basics of Environment and Pollution Control (CBT 2)

  • Basics of Environment
  • Adverse effects of environmental pollution
  • Pollution control strategies
  • Types of pollution
  • Waste Management
  • Global warming
  • Acid rain
  • Ozone depletion

8. Technical Abilities (CBT 2 – branch-specific)

This section carries 100 of the 150 marks in CBT 2 and is based on the engineering branch/discipline the candidate has applied for. The branch-wise syllabus is given below.

(A) Civil & Allied Engineering

(C) Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering

Topic Sub-topics
Electronic Components & Materials Conductors, semiconductors, insulators, magnetic materials, cells, batteries, relays, switches, MCBs, connectors

(D) Mechanical & Allied Engineering

Topic Sub-topics
Engineering Mechanics Resolution of forces, equilibrium, friction, moment of inertia, Newton's laws, projectile motion, D'Alembert's principle

Strength of Materials Stress, strain, factor of safety, thermal stresses, shear force/bending moment diagrams, torsion
Machining Lathe operations, cutting tools, shaper, slotter, planer, milling, gear manufacture
Welding Arc and gas welding, soldering, brazing, MIG/TIG welding, welding defects
Grinding & Finishing Process Metal removal principles, abrasives, grinding machines, honing, lapping, electroplating
Metrology Linear/angle measurement, comparators, surface roughness measurement, interferometry
Fluid Mechanics & Hydraulic Machinery Fluid properties, Bernoulli's equation, venturimeters, pitot tubes, centrifugal pumps

Note: The Mechanical branch syllabus, per the reference sources, also includes Industrial Management and Thermal Engineering topics (thermodynamics laws, IC engines, refrigeration cycles) that are not repeated in the table above for brevity refer to the official notification for the complete branch syllabus.

(E) Computer Science & Information Technology

Topic Sub-topics

Data Structures using C++ OOP concepts, stacks, queues, linked lists, searching and sorting algorithms
DBMS Fundamentals Data models, RDBMS, relational algebra, SQL, PL/SQL, cursors, triggers
Operating Systems (Linux) Unix/Linux architecture, file system, commands, system administration
Web Technologies Internet/Intranet, LAN, routers, HTML basics, web servers, browsers, security
Data and Network Communication OSI model, TCP/IP, transmission media, error detection/correction, Ethernet
Java Programming JVM, data types, classes, objects, inheritance, threads, applets
Software Engineering Life cycle models, requirements analysis, design principles, testing strategies, project management

(F) Printing Technology

Covers printing systems, printing materials, flexo/gravure/screen printing, printing finishing processes, image processing, design & advertising in print media, sheet-fed and web offset machines, publishing software, colour separation, plate-making methods, and printer's accounting per the branch-wise syllabus in the reference sources. Refer to the official notification for the full topic list, as this branch's syllabus is extensive.

(G) Chemical & Metallurgical Assistant (CMA)

The CMA technical syllabus covers general science topics at an intermediate level, including:

  • Measurements, units, dimensions, and errors in measurement
  • Light: reflection, refraction, interference, diffraction, polarization
  • Heat: transmission, expansion, calorimetry, latent heat
  • Sound: propagation, characteristics, resonance, Doppler effect
  • Mechanics: motion, friction, Newton's laws, momentum, gravitation
  • Magnetism and Electricity & Electromagnetism
  • Modern Physics: atomic models, radioactivity, nuclear reactions
  • Electronics and Communications: semiconductors, diodes, transistors, logic gates
  • Matter, Chemical Reactions, Acids/Bases/Salts
  • Atomic Structure and Periodic Classification of Elements
  • Chemical Bonding, Carbon and its Compounds
  • Environmental Chemistry and Metallurgy

How to Prepare for RRB JE Exam 2026

  1. Start with the syllabus, not question banks. Map out CBT 1 subjects first since it's the qualifying stage, then move to your specific Technical Abilities branch for CBT 2.
  2. Build a subject-wise timetable. Since Technical Abilities alone carries 100 of 150 marks in CBT 2, allocate proportionally more study time to your branch subjects than to General Awareness or Computer Basics.
  3. Use RRB JE previous year question papers (PYQs). This helps you understand question difficulty and recurring topic patterns across CBT 1 and CBT 2.
  4. Take sectional mock tests as you finish each subject. Don't wait until the full syllabus is done test topic-wise to catch weak areas early.
  5. Revise General Science and General Awareness weekly. These sections change least in preparation strategy but need regular touchpoints, unlike technical subjects that need deep, one-time study.
  6. Practice negative-marking-aware attempts in mocks. With 1/3 mark deducted per wrong answer, build the habit of skipping low-confidence questions during timed practice.
